chapters.title: Chapter 101 - Lord of Storms
paragraphs: "I don’t remember creating this place..." Qingyi heard Ruxue’s voice in his head, his grip on the heaven-defying thunder sword intensifying as he observed his surroundings.
Everything looked the same, the density of Qi, the deafening silence, the black, stony walls.
Nothing had changed, but Qingyi couldn’t allow himself to let his guard down.
After long moments, the answer to his doubts finally arrived.
He felt the air tremble, a thunderous crackling noise spreading throughout the fourth floor as the wall slowly opened up.
Qingyi held his sword ready. His lightning sword Qi spread across the blade, which glowed brightly.
In all the swords he had ever used, the metal immediately showed signs of fatigue when he circulated his Qi through them, but the heaven-defying thunder sword was different.
It was like a bottomless pit, devouring all the Qi poured into its blade and slowly growing stronger.
’Yes... that’s the sword I needed...’
Qingyi’s thoughts were interrupted by light footsteps approaching. His vision focused on the figure that emerged from the opening in the wall.
It was a middle-aged man, tall and handsome.
His tired face displayed a gentle smile, his clothes were luxurious but not exuberant, a black cloak covered in golden dragons and a red cape apparently made from some kind of spirit beast skin.
Watching Qingyi, the man’s eyes lit up, focusing on the sword the handsome young man was carrying.
"Greetings, young cultivator!" He spread his hands, his animated voice contrasting with the tired expression he tried and failed to hide.

"Fucking pigs!" Ruxue gritted her teeth, her sweet, mature voice filled with anger. "I insisted many times that my last bearer exterminate this family of disgusting snakes. Why did she never listen to me?"
Fortunately, her voice could only be heard in Qingyi’s mind.
’Do you know this guy?’ Qingyi asked mentally.
"Yes, it was his family together with that filthy whore who plotted the fall of my temple and ambushed my former bearer. If it hadn’t been for them..." Ruxue’s voice suddenly died away.
Through the connection with Ruxue, Qingyi felt the beauty’s emotions explode, anger, melancholy, grief.
If she manifested herself now, he was sure she would jump straight down that man’s throat.
’Calm down... I’ll deal with them when the time comes...’ Qingyi spoke.
He could barely sense that man’s Qi, but could easily deduce that he was in the Golden Core realm.

"That worm ambushed me along with two other Golden Core realm cultivators a few years ago. It was because of this ambush that my power fell so quickly. He was at the first stage of the golden core realm at the time."
’And the other two?’
"Dead. I tore out their throats and ripped out their guts myself. I have no idea how that bastard managed to escape."
Becoming uncomfortable with Qingyi’s silence, the man cleared his throat before introducing himself.
"I am Xiao Zhenwang, Lord of Storms and Monarch of the Heavenly Thunder Realm." He declared arrogantly before ordering: "What are you waiting for? Prostrate yourself before your king!"
Qingyi hesitated for a brief moment, but then knelt down, clasping his fists together.
He still wasn’t sure if he would be able to defeat this man and, for now, he preferred to just go along with him, at least until he had a chance to escape.
"Long Qingyi greets Xiao Zhenwang, Lord of Storms." Qingyi bowed his head, drawing a smile from the king.
"Good! Good!" He clapped his hands, signaling Qingyi to stand up.

"It’s been tens of thousands of years since Xiao kings ruled this kingdom. During that time, we’ve never stopped dreaming of the day when a young hero would finally be able to wield this sword and tame that cursed spirit..."
"Your Majesty’s words flatter me..." Qingyi forced out the most emotional voice he could produce, his eyes almost watering.
"Disgusting..." Ruxue’s voice took his attention away for a brief moment before he focused on the king again, whose lips rose in a wide smile.
"I’m the one who’s flattered by the presence of such a hero in my kingdom, hahaha!" Zhenwang laughed.

"Now swear allegiance to me." The king spoke, straightforwardly. "I have ten beautiful daughters, you can choose any one of them to be your wife, any land within the royal domain to rule over and the title of supreme commander of my armies!"
’Is this bastard really going to hand over so much power to a random person just because of the heaven-defying thunder sword?" Qingyi wondered.
If it had been anyone else, he would have been thrilled, but such promises didn’t touch Qingyi’s heart.
Not even a thousand princesses from this kingdom could match a single fingernail of an incomparable beauty like Ruxue.
Zhenwang noticed Qingyi’s hesitation, a warm smile taking over his face.

"There’s no need to rush, young man. Come with me to my palace, drink with me and make a decision, but first..." His voice lowered, his eyes shining with greed as they roamed over the sword in Qingyi’s hands.
"Why not let me have a look at it?" He spread his hands slightly. "Don’t worry, since it’s already accepted you, I have no way of taking it from you, I’m just curious."
"Let that filthy pig touch me and I guarantee it, I’ll blow myself up along with you and this whole place," Ruxue threatened in Qingyi’s mind, drawing a smile from him.
Yes, that was exactly how one of his women should react to the idea of being touched by another man.
Sighing heavily, Qingyi stood up, looking at his balance of lust points.
It was more than enough.
"It would be an honor to serve you, Your Majesty, but I have a question..."
"Go ahead." Zhenwang’s smile began to fade, but he kept a calm expression.
"I believe that it was your majesty and his family who hunted down the lightning spirit priestesses and killed them before they reached the sword. Am I correct?" Qingyi asked.
Those words completely wiped away the king’s smile.
His eyes were filled with a deep cold and he clenched his fists.

paragraphs: "You know... when I noticed the weakening of the lightning spirit, I was sure that it was only a matter of time before I finally got my hands on that damn sword..."
Xiao Zhenwang’s voice changed, losing its dignity and calm, being seized by a deep anger.
"But then that fucking young master Shen showed up, I was sure that was the end of our dream, even my most talented son was incomparable to him...
I thought so, until I saw you, with talent and power even superior to those arrogant bastards from the main land and without any backing..."
"I really, really thought our dream was safe..." Zhenwang brought his hands to the golden hilt of the sword he carried at his waist.
He didn’t even try to hide his murderous intent. His golden core realm aura exploded from his body, covering him in powerful thunder.
Qingyi took a step back, his knees almost bending, but he resisted.
That bastard was at least at the second stage of the Gold Core Realm.
"To dare scheme with those filthy bitches to steal our treasure..." Zhenwang gritted his teeth as he drew his sword. "The punishment is death!"
The moment his voice fell silent, Qingyi raised his weapon.
A metallic clang echoed as his body was catapulted backwards, his arms trembled and he coughed up a gout of blood, falling to his knees.
Just a single collision, and he could already feel his meridians burning.
The difference between the Golden Core realm and the Foundation realm was simply too great.
"Get up, your death won’t be quick!" Zhenwang roared, advancing towards Qingyi with slow, threatening steps.
"Ugh... motherfucker!" Qingyi punched the ground. His grip on the heaven-defying thunder sword grew even stronger as he activated the lightning steps.
His body exploded into speed, the silver blade of his sword surrounded with powerful lightning Qi as it met Zhenwang’s weapon.
"Uh?" A look of surprise appeared on the king’s face as he once again threw Qingyi away.
His eyes swept over the blade of his own sword, noticing a small cut appearing where it had met Qingyi’s.
That was one of the best swords in the kingdom, made just for him, but still, even covered by his Qi, it suffered damage when it came into contact with the heaven-defying thunder sword.
That ignited his greed even more. With that sword, he would be incomparable, especially if he could find its fragments!
Unaware of Zhenwang’s thoughts, Qingyi once again found himself falling to his knees.
His vision was still a little blurry as he called out to the system.
His eyes focused on his status screen, hesitating for a brief moment before clicking to improve his cultivation.
An intense pain ran through his entire body.
It was obvious that he wasn’t ready for a breakthrough, but he ignored it.
Taking advantage of the explosion of Qi that seized his body, he advanced, his sword tearing through the air with a thunderous whistle.
"Forced breakthrough?" Zhenwang defended himself, feeling Qingyi’s power explode around him.
’Fuck! It’s not enough! Qingyi thought as he was thrown backwards once again.
Every muscle in his body screamed in agony as he clicked to improve his cultivation again, a thousand lust points disappearing from his status screen.

’Almost there!’ Qingyi roared inwardly as his sword struck Zhenwang’s, ignoring the system’s warnings.
"Stop it, you idiot! Just try to escape!" Ruxue’s voice called out in Qingyi’s mind, but she wasn’t heard.
’Another forced breakthrough? How is that possible?" Zhenwang’s eyes finally showed an expression other than anger and contempt.
He could continue playing with Qingyi if he had made a single forced breakthrough to the fifth stage of the Foundation Realm, but now he no longer dared to do so.
"Die!" The king fended off Qingyi’s attack before striking back, this time without holding back.
Their swords met, their bodies sinking into a crater as the pressure of their lightning Qi destroyed everything around them.
"What is it?" Qingyi asked with a bloody smile, watching Zhenwang’s trembling eyes.
Another 1100 lust points disappeared from his status as he finally reached the seventh stage of the foundation realm.
His base was unstable, about to collapse, but even that didn’t wipe away the smile on his face.
"Oh... You can’t push me back anymore, can you?" Qingyi swung his sword and, this time, it was Zhenwang who stepped back.
A single step, but it was enough.
"You damned, ungrateful commoner!" Zhenwang recovered, his lightning Qi shining more brightly than ever.
His body floated briefly in the air as he retracted his sword.
"That’s my family’s ancient secret technique, succumb!" Zhenwang attacked, his sword turning into a flash of light.
At the same time, Qingyi used the first form of the Tempest Monarch’s sword art, thrusting with all his might.
Their swords met with a clang.
Qingyi felt his muscles tear, hundreds of tiny cuts drenching his arms in blood as Zhenwang’s lightning Qi spread through his blade and into his hands.
But he endured the pain, pushing on until he finally felt the resistance end.
The King’s eyes widened as the melted tip of his sword fell to the ground.
Qingyi gave Zhenwang no time to react.
Spinning his body, he drove his heaven-defying thunder sword into Zhenwang’s belly, ripping open his guts before kicking him away.

He wanted to stay like that, feeling her silky skin against his until he couldn’t, but in the end, he shook his head.
Qingyi understood her, and even felt a little bad for her. He could hardly imagine the turmoil that was going on in his head.
Getting up, he bought a recovery pill from the system and took it, his body relaxing and being taken over by an intense freshness.
His eyes then focused on the body lying on the ground and he swung his sword, wiping the blood from its blade.
Zhenwang was lying on his stomach, his back exposed to Qingyi while his Qi already seemed to have been completely dispersed.
"A king should die with some dignity, don’t you think?" Qingyi spoke, stopping beside the body.
After long moments without an answer, the handsome young man sighed, pointing his sword towards the king’s leg.
A powerful Qi of lightning descended from the blade, tearing through skin and flesh, a heartbreaking scream echoing through the fourth floor.
"You bastard!" Zhenwang turned his body, his spatial ring glowing as a sword appeared in his hands, slashing towards Qingyi’s neck.
Qingyi raised the heaven-defying thunder sword, but at the last moment, he activated the black dragon scales.
"H-how?" Zhenwang’s eyes widened as his sword bounced off Qingyi’s skin, now covered in black scales.
The next moment, a sharp pain ran through his arm, his severed hand falling to the ground as he screamed in agony.
Qingyi didn’t even bother with the king, his eyes focused on the sword on the ground.
He picked it up, studying it carefully.
"This is..." Ruxue’s voice echoed in Qingyi’s head.
It was almost identical to the swords used by the lightning priestesses, only of a much higher quality, its blade surrounded by strange scriptures.
’Do you recognize this sword?’ Qingyi asked.
"Yes... when we founded the temple, fifty swords were created for the fifty most powerful priestesses. This sword is one of those fifty..."
’I see...’ Qingyi’s vision swept across the blade, stopping at its handle.
Fused to the end of the handle was a small golden pendant, similar to some kind of pocket watch. Qingyi opened the pendant, his eyes filled with a deep tremor as he saw its contents.
At the top, a drawing that looked like it had been made by a eight-year-old child showed a blue-haired little girl, a purple-haired little girl and, embracing them, a tall woman with long black hair.
Feeling his heart sink, he looked at the clumsy writing at the bottom of the pendant.
"Happy birthday to the best master in the whole world!" Qingyi read the words before closing the pendant and taking a deep breath.
That was the sword of the old master Yueli and Elize...
His eyes were cold and his chest heavy as he turned towards Zhenwang.

"W-wait! We can negotiate! T-the royal vault, I’ll give you access to the royal vault! You can take anything you want from there! I-" Zhenwang’s pleading was interrupted by Qingyi’s boots hitting his face.
"Ugh... cough! Cough!" The king coughed up a mixture of blood and broken teeth, his face streaked with tears as he tried to drag himself away from Qingyi.
"Tell me." Qingyi crouched over him, thrusting his sword into his leg as he questioned him. "Where is the owner of this sword?"
"I-I don’t fucking know!" Zhenwang gritted his teeth, a pained grunt taking over his voice.
The almost endless vitality of Golden Core realm cultivators was both a blessing and a curse.
"Oh... so the sword magically appeared in your spatial ring?" Qingyi sent tiny threads of Qi through the blade of the heaven-defying thunder sword, pained grunts turning into screams of agony.
"Argh... SHE’S DEAD, SHIT!" Zhenwang shouted, but Qingyi ignored it.
The Xiao family was responsible for hunting down and killing the priestesses who entered the secret realm, which made it clear that their aim was to exterminate them.
They just didn’t do it until the old master left, because the temple always had at least one expert from the Golden Core realm protecting it.
But in recent years, the temple had been totally unprotected, with only a single Foundation Realm cultivator.
They could exterminate it at any time, but they didn’t.

There was only one possibility for this: the girls’ master was alive, or at least possibly alive, and the girls were being kept alive so that the Xiao family would have something to threaten her with.

paragraphs: "I-I’ll talk, I’ll talk! Please... stop!" Zhenwang screamed from the bottom of his lungs, his body covered in blood, his legs and arms turned into a bloody mess.

"Go on." Qingyi spoke, throwing an inferior healing pill towards the man, who devoured it as if it were the best delicacy of his life.
The dignity and pride of a king and expert of the Golden Core Realm were gone.
The pain had erased all that.
Catching his breath and calming his spiritual energy, Zhenwang sighed heavily, finally feeling some relief from the pain. Raising his vision, he faced Qingyi.

"You’re right, my family has been hunting down all the priestesses who come to this place since the sealing of the lightning spirit... After that happened, our power was tied with the temple, but with the support of the nobility, we got the upper hand.
They were driven into the forests while we kept control of the sealing site and the capital...
We tried many times to conquer the sword, but it always ended up with all our experts being exterminated. The spirit of lightning was too strong.

Around the same time, a group of my ancestors ended up venturing into the forbidden zone of the Heavenly Thunder Mountain. Out of ten Nascent Soul Realm cultivators, only one returned, carrying the control key to the sealing site."
Qingyi felt Ruxue’s emotions tremble through their connection, but just kept listening.

"After that, we decided to turn the sealing site into a secret realm and open it up with the hope that someday, some talent would emerge, creating various challenges and using the mountain’s thunder to keep our arrays active."
"But then, you became afraid that this talent was a priestess of lightning and that they would use this power to rise again..." Qingyi murmured, understanding everything.
"Yes... Over time without the spirit of lightning, the density of Qi on the island has dropped more and more.
Our strongest expert used to be from the Rebirth realm, but soon we only had experts from the Nascent Soul realm and it wasn’t long before our strongest expert was only in the Golden Core realm.
During all this time, despite an unwritten peace agreement, we killed everyone who dared to enter the secret realm.
We never failed... not even once... at least not until that filthy bitch-
"Watch your tongue, you won’t be able to finish the story if I pull it out." Qingyi threatened
Zhenwang swallowed his own words, his voice shaking. "You’ll let me live if I talk, won’t you?"
"I’ll keep you alive, at least until we find her. She’ll decide what happens to you."
"Ah..." A relieved sigh escaped Zhenwang’s lips. If it was that woman, he was sure there was still a chance.

"It was about twenty years ago. We had four Gold Core Realm experts at the time. We surrounded her on the second floor and ambushed her. Yet that b-" Zhenwang paused, remembering Qingyi’s threats and rethinking his next words.

"That woman was too strong, she killed one of our experts and even though she was seriously injured, she managed to push us back... So we decided to take her to the secret zone and find a way to bring her down there...
Since we weren’t sure if she was alive or not, we preferred not to attack the temple and keep the girls alive so that we’d have something to threaten her with..."
Qingyi didn’t reply, scratching his chin as he pondered.
Honestly, he just wanted to get out of there, sink into a sea of breasts and go after his Feiyan.
But what was he supposed to do? Take the sword to Yueli and say that he hadn’t even tried to go after his master? Hide the sword? Lie that he was sure her master was dead?
Even if the chances were slim, even if it was only one chance in a million, he wouldn’t be a coward.
He had been a coward long enough in his previous life on earth.

"Do you want to finish him off?" Qingyi asked Ruxue.

Her beautiful face bore a bitter expression as she took the sword from Qingyi’s hands.
"Wait, you promised! You-" the king’s words were silenced as his head was thrown into the air.

As Zhenwang was already dead, it wasn’t difficult to access the ring.
"Worthy of a king!" Qingyi’s eyes lit up.
That was a ring with a storage space of 100 cubic meters, which in itself was worth a fortune.
The ring was also full of riches, mountains of gold and endless collections of pills and alchemy and forging materials.
Unfortunately, the control key to the sealing site wasn’t there, but he didn’t think much of it.
"Ruxue, what do you know about this forbidden zone?" He asked the spiritual beauty, whose beautiful amethyst eyes had already regained some of their calm.

"It’s a hellhole where we used to seal powerful spirit beasts... In my day, there were even beasts of the rebirth realm there, but a lot of time has passed and the Qi density has dropped a lot. They must all be dead... I very much doubt that the strongest ones will make it past the Golden Core realm."
Hearing those words, Qingyi made a decision. He would use every last pill in that treasure if he had to, but in three days, he would reach the Golden Core realm before going after the girls’ master.
With his eyes shining, he opened the status screen, immediately clicking to improve his spiritual roots.

chapters.title: Chapter 106 - Get out of my way
paragraphs: "Any news about the king?" Bao Heizi, the supreme commander of the royal forces, asked, arriving on the third floor.
"No, Lord Commander, the gates remain closed. We’ve already exterminated most of the Foundation Realm beasts in the area and swept the entire third floor. Nothing suspicious has been found."
"Dammit..." Bao Heizi gritted his teeth, staring at the two gates in front of the Golden Mansion.
These gates would usually remain open until the maximum number of people entered or until the challenge to the fifth floor began.
He didn’t know much about the secrets of royal life, but he did know that the King had a certain level of control over the Stormy Secret Kingdom and was able to enter and leave it freely.
The fact that the king had entered the fourth floor and hadn’t returned obviously terrified him.

Bao Heizi had just been scolded by the High Queen in front of all the high nobility of the kingdom, and the First Prince seemed quite excited about the idea of using him as an example to strengthen his power over his brothers.
If the king didn’t return, as one of the main people responsible for protecting the royal family and the leader of its armies, it would be difficult for him not to end up taking some of the blame.
Sighing heavily, his worried eyes swept over all the soldiers around him.
The royal army had around one hundred thousand soldiers, with two hundred and fifty of them being in the Foundation Realm.
At his front were more than two hundred Foundation Realm experts, each one a great talent or a veteran soldier hardened by decades of war.
It was certainly one of the most formidable forces ever assembled in the Heavenly Thunder Kingdom since the last great revolt of the northern nobles forty years ago.
"Lord Commander! Something’s happening to the gates!" One of the Foundation Realm experts shouted, taking Bao Heizi’s attention.
’Finally, I’m safe!’ Heizi shouted in his mind, his eyes watching the gate open with interest, believing that that would be his king.
Unfortunately, it wasn’t his king who greeted him.
"They seem to have prepared a welcome party for me..." Qingyi raised his hand, covering his eyes from the brightness.
"You! Who the hell are you? Where is our king?" Bao Heizi roared, his gaze sweeping over Qingyi worriedly.
That was a handsome, striking young man. He had seen him briefly in the line to enter the city and felt his cultivation.
but now, he couldn’t feel anything, no matter how hard he tried, it was as if Qingyi didn’t even had a physical presence.
"Ah..." Qingyi exhaled, stretching his body gently before speaking: "Get out of my way, go back to your families, kiss your wives, it’s not worth dying for this."
Those words made Heizi’s blood run cold. His eyes met Qingyi’s and he shuddered.
After a moment’s hesitation, he roared: "Formation! Capture that bastard alive!"
Qingyi shook his head and with a wave, the Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword appeared in his hands.
He gave those in front of him no time to react.
A powerful lightning sword Qi spread through his blade as he used the second form of the Storm Monarch Sword Art.
"Golden Core Realm!" Heizi’s eyes widened in shock, he tried to back away, but it was too late.
A line of blood appeared on his waist and his torso was thrown into the air, his last moments awake allowing him to see the torn bodies of his soldiers falling to the ground.
Qingyi smiled at the sight. If it had been a week ago, he would surely be dead, but now, these people were like ants in front of him.
With a wave of his hands, he went to store the Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword in his special ring, but Ruxue’s thunderous voice stopped him.
"DON’T YOU DARE PUT ME IN THAT DAMN PLACE WITHOUT MY PERMISSION AGAIN!" She roared, appearing beside Qingyi.
"Do you know what it’s like to be in a special ring? Why on earth do you think they generally prevent living beings from being put there?"
Her face was flushed with anger, making Qingyi scratch the back of his head.
Well, in his haste, he had indeed put her in his special ring without asking permission.
"I’m sorry... I didn’t think much of it." He smiled awkwardly, drawing an irritated grunt from Ruxue.
"You should be." She waved in the air, and a luxurious deep purple sheath appeared in her hands before she tossed it to Qingyi.
"Is this your original scabbard?" Qingyi asked, studying the beautiful patterns that surrounded the fine leather.
"A copy, but it’s better than that hell!" Ruxue spoke, without even giving Qingyi time to reply. Her body turned into a cloud of lightning, returning to the sword.

As Qingyi’s power increased, her own power increased through their connection, but she still needed to calm this new energy. Elemental spirits were much more sensitive to unstable foundations than humans.
Giving Ruxue time, Qingyi just left, slowly making his way down to the second floor.
The royal troops had blocked everything above the second floor, so he had to kill a few more people, but once he reached the second floor, he soon blended in with the other cultivators.
He rose above the trees, his senses spreading as his eyes focused on the center of the second floor.
Activating the Lightning Steps, his body disappeared, covering the distance of kilometers quickly, stopping only when he began to see dozens of warning signs.
He landed on the ground softly, before starting to walk. It wasn’t long before he heard a bestial roar and felt a powerful aura of the Golden Core Realm.
His sight soon landed on a well hidden among the trees, its opening large enough to swallow a dragon.
Qingyi stopped beside the well, looking down. Even when he activated his Draconic Eyes, all he saw was endless darkness, sensing powerful presences in the depths.
He sighed heavily, looking at his balance of Lust points.
still had around 10,000 points, a considerable amount, at least enough to be able to buy an escape talisman if things went wrong.
Calming his mind, he jumped, his body disappearing into the darkness.

chapters.title: Chapter 107 - Scorching desert
paragraphs: It didn’t take long for Qingyi’s body to reach terminal velocity, yet the end didn’t even seem to be near.
It was almost ten minutes of falling before he finally saw the light, his eyes shining subtly as he left the stuffy walls behind, a warm breeze sweeping through his long black hair.
What he saw below was like a separate world: an endless desert, punctuated by high mountains of red stone. Above, a ceiling made of golden crystals bathed everything in an eternal, scorching light.
At the last moment before he touched the ground, he activated the lightning steps, the sand being swept under his feet as his body came to a gentle stop.
"Ugh... this place really is hell... how could anything survive here?" he wondered, his eyes scanning the surrounding dunes worriedly.

"Anything sent here has been sent to die. The only way out is a teleportation matrix in the north of the desert, but that can only be used by human hands," Ruxue replied, still inside the heaven-defying thunder sword.
"I see..." he muttered, looking around for a brief moment before sighing heavily.
This place was huge. How on earth was he going to find anyone here?
No, that wasn’t even the problem.
Even if it was a Gold Core Realm expert, would it really be possible to survive here for twenty years?
Qingyi couldn’t help feeling discouraged, but in the end, he pushed the thought out of his mind.
He had to at least try.
"Was this place created by your former bearer?" he asked as he walked aimlessly, his eyes scanning the vast expanse.
Even if it was a cultivator of the Transcendence Realm, it was hard to believe that someone had the power to create something so huge, regardless of how many thousands of years they had lived.
"No..." Ruxue spoke. Her body soon appeared beside Qingyi, her bare, delicate feet touching the sand for a brief moment before she jumped.
" Fuck, it’s hot!" She let out a suppressed squeal, using her Qi to subtly float above the sand.
Turning her face towards Qingyi, she noticed the smiling expression on his face, as if he had seen a cute kitten.
She blushed, looking away for a brief moment before regaining her composure.
"This place already existed when we got here. It could be the site of some fire dragon’s death or some remnant of-"
Ruxue suddenly stopped talking, her beautiful amethyst eyes fluttered and Qingyi felt a strange emotion coming from his connection with her.
"What happened? Remnants of what?" he asked, one of his hands reaching for the spiritual beauty’s face while the other grasped her hips, watching her expression fall apart.
"It’s okay... just things I shouldn’t talk about. I’ll cultivate a bit..." Ruxue had a complex look on her face as her body returned to the sword.
"Ah..." Qingyi sighed.
’System, do you know anything?’ He asked mentally.

[There are things that should not be spoken of below the celestial heavens. You’re not affected by this because the heavens don’t recognize you, but as an elemental spirit, Ruxue is much more connected to the heavens. The punishment for saying the wrong thing is cruel].
Hearing those words, Qingyi no longer questioned it.
Putting his worries out of his mind, he decided to use a new method to search.
Kneeling on the hot sand, he sank his fingers into it, closing his eyes.
The affinity enhancement pill had increased his lightning affinity by seven points.
It seemed like a small increase, but circulating his lightning Qi, Qingyi had to admit that it was incredible.
His ability to sense and manipulate Qi had increased greatly, and although he wasn’t yet at the level of a breakthrough in cultivation, it was still considerable.
His plan was simple: send small signals of Qi through the desert areas, using them as a radar that would come back to him if it found anything.
It wasn’t the most efficient method and it probably wouldn’t work if the target wasn’t in battle, but Qingyi still preferred to go for it.
To survive in this place for twenty years, hunting spirit beasts almost daily was a requirement. If she were alive, she would have to do it.
It could obviously reveal his position to other beasts in the area, but fortunately, spirit beasts weren’t smart enough to follow that kind of signal.
After a moment’s hesitation, he sent out the first pulse.
The answer came soon after: about two Foundation Realm spirit beasts fighting a few kilometers away.
’That’s not it...’ He sent a second pulse, this time getting no response.
He continued sending pulses every thirty seconds.
His body was already sweating when he finally received a response: two powerful golden core realm beasts battling against a third entity using lightning Qi.
"A human!" Qingyi exclaimed, feeling the way that entity used Qi, very differently from what spirit beasts usually did.
Standing up, he quickly activated the lightning steps, his body exploding with speed and his face filled with anxiety.
It was close, no more than a few kilometers away, but he still needed to run as fast as he could.
It was obvious that the battle was not in the human’s favor.
"Die!" A soft, tired voice entered Qingyi’s ears, and he finally saw it.
She was a middle-aged woman, but one whose beauty was far from even beginning to fade, long black hair framing piercing eyes and plump cherry lips.

Her body was covered in tattered white robes, her large, heavy breasts almost jutting out of the open cleavage while parts of the pale skin of her voluptuous ass and thick thighs were exposed by the rips in the fabric.
She had no sword with her, fighting with her bare hands, her fists landing against the carapace of a seventh-stage golden core realm fire scorpion with a thud.
At the same time, behind her, a second scorpion emerged from the sand, its already poison-dripping tail lashing out towards her delicate back.
She turned her body, dodging the sting but still being hit by the tail.
Her beautiful face contorted into a pained expression as she was thrown towards the burning sands.
Qingyi immediately drew the Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword, his eyes blazing with murderous intent as he advanced.

chapters.title: Chapter 108 - Escape
paragraphs: The woman’s beautiful black eyes were filled with hope, but that hope disappeared the moment she felt the cultivation of the handsome young man in front of her.

"Don’t come, run away! I can hold them off!" She shouted as she tried to get up, but her body weakened and she coughed up large gulps of blood, the little Qi in her dantian barely able to maintain her consciousness.
Qingyi noticed the woman’s condition, his eyes glowing a deep purple as he used the first form of the Storm Monarch Sword Art.
The Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword turned into a blur as it slammed into the shell of one of the scorpions.
"What?" Qingyi’s eyes widened, a metallic clang echoing as he felt a painful tremor spread through his arms.
All that power, and all it did was get a tiny crack, blue blood squirting out as the creature shuddered painfully.
The second scorpion took advantage of Qingyi’s diverted focus to attack him, its tail covered in flaming Qi as it tore through the air.
Qingyi realized the danger immediately, raising his sword and planting his feet on the ground.
A loud crash echoed as he defended himself, the sand providing little support for his feet which sank almost to his knees before he was catapulted backwards for dozens of meters.
"Ah... this is going to be more complicated than I expected..." he gritted his teeth.
The first scorpion was only at the third stage of the golden core realm and it was a fight he could certainly win, but the second, on the other hand, was at the sixth stage of the golden core realm.
He could hold his own against a human cultivator of that level, but against a spirit beast? It was very difficult.
He looked towards the beauty, whose consciousness had almost faded, her opaque and trembling eyes focused on the sword in his hands.
He had to find a way to get an opening and escape from there, but with the two scorpions focusing on him at the same time, it would be almost impossible to stand a chance.
’I just need to get rid of one of them...’ he thought, his sword glowing with lightning sword Qi as he took a step forward.
The scorpion of the sixth stage of the golden core attacked, its huge pincers closing in, trying to break Qingyi in half.
The handsome young man waited until the last moment to activate the lightning steps, the scorpion’s pincers just grazing his boots as he leapt over it.
His feet landed on the tail whose sting narrowly missed him before he launched himself towards the scorpion at the third stage of the foundation realm.
He felt his body burn as he put all his power into that attack, using the first form of the Storm Monarch’s Sword Art.
The Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword shone more brightly than ever, its sharp steel hissing as it sliced through the air.
The scorpion tried to raise its tail to protect the wound on its shell, but Qingyi’s sword passed right through it.
Qingyi wasn’t aiming at the wound, he was aiming at the junction between the scorpion’s plates.
With his draconic eyes activated, it wasn’t difficult for the tip of the sword to hit its target, sinking between the gaps in the scorpion’s shell, which closed, trying to stop the penetration.
But it was too late.
The lightning sword Qi tore through the flesh and organs inside the creature, its fire Qi unable to stop Qingyi.
The moment the beast’s body lost its strength and collapsed heavily onto its abdomen, the other one was already on top of Qingyi.
Its body was engulfed in a tornado of flames as it advanced.
It was a dangerous attack, but Qingyi didn’t dodge, just raised his blade.
His clothes burned and his arms almost gave way as his body was catapulted backwards, but he couldn’t stop himself from smiling.
That was exactly what he wanted.
Using the momentum of the scorpion’s attack, he threw himself towards the black-haired beauty, wrapping her in a gentle embrace as he took her in his arms.
Her voluptuous body pressed against his, a soft sigh escaping her plump lips.
Qingyi had no time, immediately activating the lightning steps, turning into a blur as he ran as fast as he could.
Watching Qingyi flee, the scorpion shuddered, its huge body sinking and forming waves in the burning sand as it advanced towards him.
’Damn, that bastard is fast! Qingyi gritted his teeth, forcing his lightning steps to the point where his legs went numb.
"Ah..." The lips of the beauty in his embrace opened subtly, a tremor taking over her body as she felt his powerful hands sinking into her curves.
Her face flushed slightly and she turned her gaze, using what little strength she had to point towards a mountain of red rocks on the horizon.
"T-there..." she said, her voice almost a whisper before her consciousness faded again.
Qingyi looked in the direction she had pointed, turning his body quickly before starting to run towards it.
But suddenly, he realized something.
The beast had stopped following him, its body rising above the ground for a brief moment before it hid again, sinking deep down.
Why?
"It’s getting dark... the crystals go out in a 48-hour cycle, everything freezes when they go out," Ruxue spoke in her mind, prompting Qingyi to grit his teeth, hastening his pace even more.
It wasn’t difficult for a cultivator of the Golden Core realm to maintain their temperature, but that woman was seriously injured, her Qi reserves already at an end.
If she didn’t get shelter immediately, she would hardly be able to hold out for long.
Hastening his steps even more, Qingyi reached the foot of the mountains. It was already dark when he saw a small hole covered by a piece of cloth.
Without hesitation, he entered it, immediately placing the beauty on the ground and taking a recovery pill from the king’s space ring.
He held the corners of her jaw, her full, pink lips parting and receiving the pill between them.
"Shit, she’s not swallowing..." Qingyi thought for a brief moment before pulling out a bottle of wine, also from the king’s space ring.

He popped the cork before pouring a big gulp into his mouth and bending down, his face hovering inches from hers for a brief moment before finally pressing his lips to hers, using the liquid to make the pill go down.

But there is a solution to this. This tunnel goes down for many kilometers, at the bottom of which is a garden of spiritual herbs."
Xia Yunfei waved her hands and a small branch appeared in her fingers, its tip decorated with greenish leaves and a bright red fruit.
What really caught Qingyi’s attention was what it exuded; a pure and intense Qi, enough to make his cultivation move slightly just by observing it.
"There are hundreds of these herbs, more than enough for me to advance with some level of safety, but there’s a problem.

As it descends, there is another source of icy Qi in the depths of the tunnel, at a level where even all my Qi at full strength is unable to stop it. This herb was the only one I managed to catch before I was forced to flee."
’Hm...’ Qingyi scratched his chin thoughtfully.
A Qi capable of making even someone like Yunfei suffer was not something he wanted to deal with.
With his current battle ability, he could even cross stages and battle against the sixth stage of the Golden Core realm, but he was still incomparable to her if she was at her maximum power.
His eyes scanned the countless items in the system, looking for something that could help him, his eyes shining as he finally found something.
[Item: Set of the three-bladed monarch
Description: An ancient set worn by a master assassin who, despite having died before fully blossoming, was still able to make history.
These robes are made of a special silk that is able to regenerate and change its shape and color to anything the wearer wishes.
Its interior is surrounded by spiritual arrays that increase resistance to various types of Qi and help conceal the wearer
Grade: Epic
The price was honestly absurd, but Qingyi barely paid any attention to it.
Compared to what such a set would cost at auction, it was even a little cheap.
"I know how to solve this," he smiled, but didn’t get up immediately.
His grip on the two beauties’ breasts tightened a little more, their voluptuous, naked bodies shuddering as they moaned softly.
"Do you want to sort this out now or stay like this for a bit longer?" he asked, his fingers circling the nipples of both of them slowly.
"Mmmh~~ I want to stay... but we can’t do that, can we? The girls are waiting for us," Yunfei replied, but made no move to leave.
"And this place is going to start collapsing soon. As soon as the crystals turn golden again, we have to get out of here," Ruxue spoke, her boobs jiggling heavily as she stood up.

"How do you plan to deal with the cold? I’ve tried many methods, I was hunting fire scorpions to try and get fire Qi cores, but that didn’t work either," Xia Yunfei followed Ruxue’s movements, picking up her clothes from the ground and getting dressed.
"It’s simple," Qingyi smiled and, still naked, watched twenty thousand lust points disappear from his swing.
The next moment, a faint light covered his body, descending from his neck to his legs.
When this light reached his feet, he found himself covered in a mantle so light that it didn’t even seem to be there, its pure white fabric glowing softly in the dim light of the place.
"That’s..." not to mention Yunfei, even Ruxue herself looked shocked.
They could both sense that these were no ordinary clothing. Qingyi’s presence didn’t disappear, but it still diminished considerably.
Where did Qingyi get such items?
"It’s a set focused on concealment, but it also has arrays to protect against different types of Qi. With that, it might be possible," Qingyi explained, staring at the two women.
"Yes... it could be..." Yunfei murmured, running her fingers through the silk of Qingyi’s robes.
"I’m going now, the sooner we start your advance the better," Qingyi said as he strapped the heaven-defying thunder sword around his waist.
He opened the system store, paying two thousand lust points for a high-level cultivation pill.
"hmm?" Yunfei’s eyes twitched as she held the pill in her hands.
The quality was high, much higher than any pill she’d ever seen in the entire Heavenly Thunder Kingdom, enough for her to begin to heavily doubt Qingyi’s origins.
Even if he was someone from the main land, such items simply shouldn’t be accessible to a ordinary Golden Core Realm cultivator.
"Husband..." She called out, still feeling a little awkward about calling him that, even though she herself had asked to be his woman. "Who are you?"
Qingyi paused for a moment, Ruxue turning back to the sword as he thought of an answer.
He remembered the answer he gave Feiyan when she first asked him that question, but that probably wasn’t the answer Yunfei wanted.
"I’m a disciple of the Ascending Dragon Sect who ended up having a lot of fortuitous encounters," Qingyi said, hoping that would be enough.
He didn’t even give her time to reply before continuing: "Now focus on cultivating while I go after the spirit herbs."
Yunfei stood still for a moment as Qingyi’s back disappeared into the darkness of the tunnel.
She clutched her chest, a soft ache running through her heart as she found herself alone again.
But she forced herself to be strong. She had endured decades alone here, without any human contact, just a few more hours would make little difference.
She looked at the pill in her hand before popping it into her mouth and starting to cultivate,.
"Yueli... Elize... Lingxi ... Ziyan..." She recited the name of each of her twenty disciples as she felt the powerful Qi of the pill spread through her meridians.
"Just a little longer and I’ll be with you..."

chapters.title: Chapter 115 - Icy flower
paragraphs: "Ugh..." Qingyi couldn’t help but shiver slightly as he walked down the tunnel.
The walls around him were already completely covered in ice, and even the Three Bladed Monarch set seemed insufficient to fully protect him from the icy Qi.
Fortunately, his constitution was powerful enough to withstand it alone, and the little that passed through the set was only uncomfortable, nothing more.
He had been walking for more than two hours, and the icy Qi was getting stronger and stronger.
Luckily, the tunnel was wide and all the passages that could lead him astray had already been marked by Yunfei.
"I think we’re getting closer..." Ruxue spoke from inside the sword, and Qingyi nodded as he saw a blue glow illuminating the end of the tunnel on the horizon.

He activated his draconic eyes, observing the thick lines of pure Qi that accompanied the blue glow, superior in intensity even to the lines that formed the highest quality cultivation chambers in the Ascending Dragon Sect.
He took a deep breath before moving forward, stopping his steps when he found himself in a large room.
The floor was covered in tall, strange, bluish grass. Amongst this vegetation, a countless number of different spiritual herbs were growing vibrantly.
Most had an affinity with ice, but many exuded pure Qi.
This was a natural spiritual garden, and one of the largest Qingyi had ever seen in his life. Even in books, such vast spiritual gardens were rare.

As he walked towards the center, he felt the air around him cool down even more, to a level where even the protections of the Three Bladed Monarch set began to fail, his constitution being forced to endure the cold alone.
Without wasting any more time, Qingyi crouched down and started collecting herbs.
He was curious to find out what was causing that cold Qi, but he was also in a hurry.
He didn’t know how long Yunfei’s advance would take and, even if it was quick, they would still have to wait for the golden crystals to shine again since.
After a few minutes, he finally reached his limit and examined his spatial ring.
There were almost six hundred spirit herbs of various kinds, from Golden Spirit Grass to Thousand-Year Mortal Jade Flowers.
He couldn’t help but feel a little pain in his heart as he looked back.
He had barely collected twenty-five percent of the herbs in the place, and those that remained would be enough to make him a fortune when he returned to the sect.
Even so, he forced himself to step back.
His hands were already numb and if he stayed there any longer, his body would begin to suffer.
He walked towards the garden exit with quick steps, but stopped at the last moment.
His eyes focused on something below him, feeling a particularly intense chill against the sides of his feet.
He took a step back and crouched down.
Below him was a small flower, with petals similar to roses, but bluish and brittle.
Qingyi brought his fingers close to it, feeling the powerful ice Qi concentrate on him with enough intensity to freeze his fingertips.
Covering himself with lightning sword Qi, he finally grabbed the flower, pulling it out of the ground and placing it in his spatial ring.
In the next moment, the ground beneath her feet shook and the powerful freezing Qi surrounding the garden seemed to disappear.
Qingyi’s eyes sparkled, but this sparkle didn’t last long.
Before he could even move, the spiritual herbs on the ground began to wither and die.
Was it that flower that was keeping the garden alive? But how?
Gritting his teeth, he drew his sword and used the second form of the Storm Monarch’s sword art, cutting down as many spirit herbs as he could.
As he expected, only the ones on the ground died, as if some array had sucked out all their life force the moment he took out that icy flower.
"Ruxue," Qingyi called out, taking the flower from his storage ring. "Do you know what kind of flower this is?"
"No," she shook her head. "But it doesn’t look like something from Mortal Heaven, nor does it look fully mature. To exude such strong Qi before it’s even fully matured, it can’t be an ordinary item.
"Hm..." Qingyi thought for a moment before trying to use the system to see its information.
Again, nothing. In the end, he just put it away, deciding to ask Feiyan or her master when he found them again.
With a sigh, he picked up all the spiritual herbs on the ground and took one last look at the now dead garden before entering the tunnels, heading up towards Yunfei.
The black-haired beauty was still cultivating peacefully, her eyes closed and her breathing calm and slow.
Sensing Qingyi’s presence, she opened her eyes, smiling subtly at the handsome young man.
"Was everything all right?" She asked, getting up. The effect of the pill had worn off, but she still felt full of energy.
The pills she had with her ran out in a few months when she arrived in this place and taking a cultivation pill after so long depending only on the miserable Qi density on the desert was liberating.
"Yes," Qingyi nodded as he accessed his spatial ring.
The room was immediately filled with a pure, deep Qi as hundreds of spiritual herbs left his ring.
Yunfei’s eyes were filled with shock. How had Qingyi gotten that many?
Even with the protections of the set he was wearing, she didn’t think he’d get more than a few dozen before being forced to retreat.
"Is that enough?" Qingyi asked, smiling as he noticed the expression that covered her face.
"Enough? With that many, I should have more than a fifty percent chance of advancing!" she exclaimed, picking up the spirit herbs and starting to organize them.
The Iron Body Realm, a level that was only a dream for almost every expert in the Heavenly Thunder Realm.
She would finally reach that level, and all because of one person - the same one who had finally claimed the Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword and who would allow her to meet her disciples again.

chapters.title: Chapter 116 - just a little...
paragraphs: [Name: Long Qingyi
Age: 18
Cultivation: Third stage of the golden core realm (2800 lust points to upgrade)
Affinities: Lightning 67 - Sword: 60 - Charm: 1000 (can be upgraded in the lust store)
Spiritual roots: Low level lightning sword root (100,000 lust points to upgrade, new roots can be bought in the lust store).
Bloodline: Blood of the Corruption Dragon God (Epic grade, 500,000 lust points to upgrade.)
Constitution: Body of the primordial dragon (Epic grade, 500,000 lust points to upgrade.)
Lust points: 18.717]
Qingyi looked at his information screen with a complicated look on his face.
After buying the Three Bladed Monarch set, a cultivation pill and a breakthrough pill for Yunfei, that was all that was left.
He had left Yunfei alone to avoid disturbing her during her breakthrough. Distractions at that moment could be deadly.
Now he was back in the dead garden, sitting in the center of it while he pulled out some more spirit herbs.
There were only a little over fifty of them, but that was enough.
His eyes were filled with a subtle glow as he arranged them around him, feeling all their pure Qi flowing towards him.
After a short moment, he finally decided that it was time for his talent to increase even further.
[Initiating spirit root enhancements!]
He clicked on enhance spirit roots, his body immediately seized with intense pain as his meridians ripped apart and were slowly rebuilt.
It was even more painful than when he had last improved it, but now, he was used to the pain.
[Spirit roots improved! Ninth level lightning spirit root -> Low-level lightning spirit root]
He felt the difference immediately. His meridians sucked in the surrounding Qi incessantly, the spiritual herbs trembling as they were drained.
Without hesitation, he clicked to improve his cultivation.
[Your cultivation has increased! First stage of the Golden Core Realm -> Second stage of the Golden Core Realm].
He felt the power explode in his body and, without hesitation, clicked to improve his cultivation again.
[Your cultivation has increased! Second stage of the Golden Core realm -> Third stage of the Golden Core realm].
With that last breakthrough, the herbs around him finally dried up completely, their glow ceasing and their leaves no longer exuding pure Qi.
"Ah..." He sighed, keeping his eyes closed as he stabilized his base.
At that moment, Ruxue left the sword, circling Qingyi while her eyes shone with a strange light.
Her face held a hint of uncertainty, but she didn’t say anything, waiting for Qingyi to stabilize his base first.
"Is everything all right?" Qingyi asked, opening his eyes and noticing the expression on Ruxue’s face.
"Qingyi..." She called out, hesitating for a brief moment before asking. "Do you have a system?"
"Uh?" Qingyi raised his face, surprised.
He thought for a moment. Ruxue would be by his side forever, he didn’t think it would be a problem to talk about it now.
"Yes, the lineage of the Dragon God of Corruption came with a system to help me inherit it more easily." He nodded and Ruxue breathed a sigh of relief.
"Systems are common in the Celestial Heaven? Why does that worry you?"

"They’re not common," she shook her head. "But they do exist. Once every few thousand mortal generations, one always appears. As for my worry... it’s nothing." She went back inside the sword, leaving a confused Qingyi behind.
[She was probably thinking that you had made a contract with a demon.]
’Demon? Like the ones in the demon cult?’
[No, real demons, beings that aren’t below even the gods themselves. They shouldn’t exist in such an isolated place, but it’s a more realistic possibility than my existence].
’I understand...’ Qingyi stood up, no longer questioning it, his eyes returning to his status screen.

Affinities: Lightning 67 - Sword: 60 - Charm: 1000 (can be upgraded in the lust store)

Lust points: 3417]
Qingyi was poor again, but not a hint of worry crossed his face.
As he prepared to climb the tunnels again, he heard a bang. A powerful Qi of lightning took over everything around him.
Qingyi activated the lightning steps, returning to the room where the beauty cultivated alone.
His eyes immediately focused on a voluptuous, naked figure, her eyes firmly closed as she floated in the air, her lightning Qi tearing apart everything around her.
[Name: Xia Yunfei
Age: 103
Corruption: 32/125
Chastity: Taken
Lust: 3%
Talent: Genius
Reward: Extremely high
Cultivation: First stage of the Iron Body realm.
Spiritual roots: Low-level lightning spiritual root.
Lineage: None
Constitution: None
Traits: Faithful, loving teacher, most faithful follower of the lightning spirit, foolish dreamer, repressed desires].
Qingyi looked at her information screen, a big smile taking over his face.
She had made a breakthrough.
Xia Yunfei’s beautiful black eyes opened, focusing on Qingyi. The aura around her body ceased as she threw herself towards him.
"Thank you, husband!" She embraced Qingyi, pulling him against her large breasts, drowning him between her twin mountains that now seemed even fuller than before.
"For what?" He smiled gently, grabbing her hips.
"For everything!" She kissed him without holding back, unable to hide the excitement taking over her body.
Qingyi just slapped her hard on the ass as he hugged her.
"We still have a bit of time before the golden crystals come back, don’t we? Not that that’s a problem for you right now." Qingyi smiled slightly as he pushed her back against the bed.
For an Iron Body Realm expert, even dozens of beasts at the ninth stage of the Golden Core Realm were like ants.
That was the difference between the two realms.
"I think we can have a little fun before we go... just a little..." Yunfei gasped and soon, panting moans filled the room.
It wasn’t long before a flushed Ruxue appeared from the sword, also joining them.

"I understand, Master..." Feiyan bowed her head and forced firmness into her voice.
"I won’t embarrass the sect.
Victory will be mine!"
"Good girl!" Madame Xue laughed, stroking her disciple’s hair.
She couldn’t deny that she was proud.
Her disciple’s cultivation speed was incomparable and her talent in alchemy was even superior.
Madame Xue was sure that if Feiyan continued at this pace, it wouldn’t be long before she would be considered the most talented disciple in the sect in the last thousand years, perhaps even more.
With a gentle smile, Madame Xue stood up, her eyes focusing on the luxurious table on a marble stage.
"The king’s speech is about to start, so I have to go." She waved in the air, a pill appearing in her hand.
"Spend the night cultivating.
Make sure your Qi reserves are full for tomorrow."
"Yes, master." Feiyan took the pill, a complicated look dominating her face as she watched her master join the king’s table.
In the end, she just shook her head and turned her attention to the royal speech.

chapters.title: Chapter 122 - Alchemy tournament (02)
paragraphs: "When are we going to see each other again?" Elize asked, trying to find space in Qingyi’s arms with the other girls.
"A few weeks at most," Qingyi replied, kissing the purple-haired beauty before turning to the other girls.
After kissing each one of them, Qingyi broke free from the girls’ embrace and stepped out of the large flying ship. Turning around, he watched the flying ship sail away.
In the end, he just shook his head.
This was the path of cultivation, lonely and cruel, there was simply no changing it. Only when he reached the top of the top could he perhaps never worry about separations like that again.
Qingyi pushed these thoughts aside and blended in with the crowds, walking towards a large building on the horizon.
This was the royal family’s arena, a huge circular building capable of allowing experts from the Iron Body realm to fight freely and with space for more than fifty thousand spectators.
"They say that the competition in the tournament for the crown prince’s breakthrough pill is very fierce!"
"Yes, I’ve heard that even a disciple from the Burning Heart Sect will be taking part against that talent from the Ascending Dragon Sect, Hua Feiyan."
"The crown prince has fire spirit roots, right? Won’t the Burning Heart Sect have too big an advantage?"
"Maybe, but I hear that Fairy Feiyan’s talent is so great that it doesn’t even make a difference!"
Qingyi listened to the many rumors, unable to hide a proud smile. His Feiyan was now famous, not just in the sect, but even in the kingdom’s capital.
He looked up, observing the almost endless line of cultivators gathering in front of the arena.
"Halt!" One of the guards roared at Qingyi, who ignored the line. "Only those who have bought tickets in advance can enter. If you have a ticket, go back to the end of the line and wait your turn."
"I’m a disciple of the Ascending Dragon Sect," Qingyi said, taking out his disciple token.
"Hm..." The guard examined the token and, after ensuring that it was real and sensing Qingyi’s cultivation, allowed him to enter.
The Ascending Dragon Sect were honored guests and obviously didn’t need to worry about things like lines.
"Thank you," Qingyi took the token back before finally entering the arena, walking through the crowded and noisy stands until he found a seat.
His eyes scanned the crowd and the arena, where ten golden cauldrons could be seen.
The competitors were already in front of their cauldrons, waiting for the competition to begin.
His heart fluttered at the sight of a woman in the center cauldron.
Her tanned skin glowed in the sunlight, her beautiful brown eyes carrying a cold, disinterested expression as she raised her face to face the king’s seat.
The tournament was about to begin.
The king of the Golden Sun Kingdom cleared his throat. His eyes were like gold and his long white hair framed a face that was old but still bore the dignity and beauty of his prime.
Next to him stood a man, his son, who seemed to be even older than his own father, his eyes full of lust focused on the tanned beauty.
A look that Qingyi obviously noticed.
’Let’s see if you can keep that smile when I gouge those eyes out...’ Qingyi gritted his teeth, but controlled himself.
That damned old man’s time would come.

"I’ve ruled this kingdom for 250 years, but never in my entire life have we had the presence of such noble and talented young alchemists. May the heavens bless you and may the one who makes the best pill win!"
The moment the king’s thunderous voice fell silent, a large bell rang out, signaling the start of the tournament.
Hua Feiyan approached her cauldron, studying the ingredients before preparing to start, but stopped at the last moment, feeling a look on her back, different from that of all the other men.
Turning her head, her eyes met those of a handsome young man.
Despite the distance and the thousands of people surrounding him, the sight of a Golden Core Realm expert was simply too powerful for her to miss a face she remembered so well.
"H-husband?" she called out, her voice low, almost a whisper.
Was that really him? How could he already be there?
She felt her heart tremble and her eyes water.
She wanted to throw herself at him right now, but the next moment, a voice came into her mind, stopping her.
"What are you waiting for, honey? Concentrate! You don’t want to embarrass your husband in front of the whole kingdom, do you?"
Was that... sound transmission?
How could Qingyi do that? Was he already in the Golden Core Realm?
Feiyan couldn’t help but be even more shocked, her plump red lips quivered and she took a step towards him.
But in the end, she turned back to the cauldron.
Her husband and her master were there, watching her. She wouldn’t let them down.
Feiyan threw the materials into the cauldron and pressed her hands against it.
Earth Qi wasn’t the best for alchemy, lagging a step behind water and fire Qi, but with her bloodline, that was not a ploblem.
With a grunt, she activated her Qi and her bloodline. The cauldron shook and a powerful pulse of energy spread out.
She sensed the ingredients inside and slowly began to mix them.
First, golden sky grass, breaking it into small pieces and mixing it with the thousand-year-old spiritual ginseng, before finally starting to add other ingredients to increase the pill’s fire Qi.
Alchemy was a slow and exhausting process. Mixing the ingredients was easy, but refining them required a level of control that few could achieve.
It was only after three hours that the first of the ten challengers finished his pill.
A disappointed sigh echoed as an ordinary-looking young man held a pill in his hands. A greenish glow surrounded it for a brief moment before fading away.
That meant it was a pill of 60% purity or lower.
It was good enough for an ordinary cultivator, but for someone like the crown prince, anything below 75% purity was garbage.
The other results weren’t much better, the highest quality pill only having a purity of just over 77%.
Soon, only the young alchemist from the Burning Heart Sect and Feiyan were left.
The young man flashed an arrogant smile as his cauldron burst open with a thunderous explosion.
The Qi from this explosion was capable of making even Foundation Realm cultivators retreat.
"8-80% purity?" A voice rang out in the crowd as shock spread. The pill in the young man’s hands glowed with pure purple aura, a sign that its purity was above 80%.
"Come on, I want to see you do better than that," the Burning Dragon Sect alchemist taunted, barely managing to distract Feiyan for a single moment before she sighed heavily and backed away.
An even louder explosion echoed as her cauldron opened, a pill landing on her fingers.
This one was different from everyone else’s. It seemed to be made of pure gold, a blinding golden light spreading across the arena.
Feiyan observed the pill, her eyes turning to Qingyi.
Her heart pounded when she saw his impressed and proud expression, the same one her master had.
That was a pill with over 90% purity, a rare level even among the most expensive pills in the Nine Peaks Basin.

chapters.title: Chapter 123 - if you had such riches
paragraphs: The moment Feiyan’s pill was revealed and its glow blinded the entire arena, the winner became clear.
The young alchemist from the Burning Heart Sect remained paralyzed.
He could clearly see the pill of the tanned beauty, feel its power, but still refused to believe it.

How could someone of his generation produce such a pill? Even his master had only created a handful of them in over two hundred years of life, and they were only pills for the Qi refinement realm, not the foundation realm.
He only woke up from his shock when his own pill slipped between his fingers, falling to the ground with a sharp crack.
He turned his face to his master, an old man with gray hair and a short beard who was standing next to the king.
Despite his defeat, the master didn’t look angry - his disappointment had been replaced by intense shock.
The crown prince leaned towards the king, whispering something before turning his lustful gaze on Feiyan again.
The monarch sighed heavily, glancing at Madame Xue sitting to his right before standing up, focusing his attention on Hua Feiyan.
She was indeed a glamorous woman, and he understood why his son was so fixated on her.
Now, seeing her talent, the king himself couldn’t help but wonder how much the royal family would gain if they won over such a talent.
"Hua Feiyan, core disciple of the Ascending Dragon Sect," he called out, a gentle smile playing across his face as he watched the beauty kneel down.
"Hua Feiyan, core disciple of the Ascending Dragon Sect, hails your majesty, supreme monarch of the Golden Sun Kingdom!" She clenched her fists, drawing a smile from the king, who extended his hand.
The pill was snatched from Feiyan’s hand by an invisible force, flying into the hand of the king, who examined it carefully.
"It’s an incredible creation. The younger generation is truly surpassing us." He shook his head.

"It’s only natural that it should receive a suitable reward." The king nodded and an intense light emerged from his spatial ring, revealing an ancient forge that looked like it was made of pure jade, materialized in front of the beauty.
"Wait... isn’t that the royal family’s sacred forge?"
"Wasn’t the prize just gold and prestige? Why would the king offer something so valuable?"
Shocked murmurs spread through the crowd.
Qingyi couldn’t help clenching his fists as he stood up, his eyes catching the crown prince’s ecstatic expression.
"Such an expensive item seems more like a wedding dowry than a prize for a competition," Ruxue spoke into Qingyi’s mind, whose eyes grew even colder.
Why had so many royal pigs been begging for the steel of the heaven-defying thunder sword lately?

"This is my family’s ancestral forge, a legendary item passed down for generations and which would arouse the greed of even cultivators from the nine peaks basin," the king spoke as he leapt into the arena, his son following close behind.
"Accept this gift as a token of goodwill for my son’s marriage proposal. He will be the next king and you the next queen."
Feiyan shuddered, biting her lower lip and struggling not to show her contempt for the old man at the king’s side.
"I’m sorry, my king, but I’m already a married woman and my life belongs to my husband. I cannot accept such a gift." She said, bowing her head.
The king hesitated for a moment, exchanging glances with his son before shaking his head.
They had come too far to give up just because of that.
"Is he here? I’m sure we can come to an agreement," the king said, his eyes sweeping the crowd.
Feiyan’s full, red lips opened, but no answer came. It wasn’t necessary.
"Yes, her husband is here." An angry growl echoed as a young man leapt down from the stands.
Qingyi landed softly on the arena, his eyes bloodshot.
At the same moment, dozens of royal guards burst onto the arena, their golden core realm auras falling on Qingyi as they surrounded him.
"Enough, let him through," the king waved his hand and the guards cleared the way.
"Third-stage Golden Core realm at a young age, that’s a frightening talent." The king’s eyes flicked to the disciple token on Qingyi’s waist before turning his gaze to Madame Xue.
Feiyan’s master had a shocked look on her face, checking Qingyi’s cultivation several times.
How could he have advanced so far and so quickly with such a weak spiritual root? Even under the care of an expert from the nine peaks basin, it was hard to believe in such a speed of cultivation.
"How can such a talent only be an external disciple?" The king asked.
"I had a few Fortuitous encounters and ended up advancing faster than my disciple status would allow, Your Majesty," Qingyi spoke coldly, coming face to face with the king.

"’Fortuitous encounters’? You’re parasitizing Feiyan, I’m sure of it! You don’t deserve a woman of her caliber!" The crown prince roared, but cowered behind his father as he received murderous looks from Qingyi and the tanned beauty simultaneously.
The king glanced at his son before letting out a tired sigh.
"Say boy, what do you want? What riches attract you? What can I offer you to erase Feiyan from your mind?"
The king’s words were answered with nothing but a laugh full of contempt.
"I beg your pardon, Your Majesty, but if you had such riches, you wouldn’t be ruling a mediocre little kingdom in a forgotten place like this."
"Qingyi..." Feiyan called, her voice full worry.
She approached him, grabbing his arm and pulling him closer, pressing his biceps against the warm, soft embrace of her huge breasts.
This was an embrace that Qingyi had missed for a long time, but he didn’t shift his focus.
"How dare you speak like that in front of your king!" The crown prince roared, the royal guards surrounding them unable to contain their own murderous intentions.
"Aren’t you afraid of losing your tongue, boy?" The king gritted his teeth.

His Iron Body Realm aura exploded, his voice coming out more like the growl of a beast than the words of a monarch. "Give up this woman, hand her over to me and I promise to just rip off one of your arms."

chapters.title: Chapter 124 - I’ve seen enough
paragraphs: "She’s not something that can be handed over, you senile old man." Qingyi responded to the king’s growl, whose aura exploded with even more fury.
Qingyi shuddered, but didn’t give in, even covering Feiyan with his Qi, preventing her from being affected by the crushing pressure.
The king was an expert of the second stage of the Iron Body Realm, but he was only using 30% of his power.
That would be enough to crush any ordinary third-stage Gold Core cultivator dozens of times over, but Qingyi was no ordinary cultivator.
"Who do you think you are?" Madame Xue finally lost patience, her aura of the sixth stage of the Iron Body Realm spreading and forcing the king to back down.

"Have you forgotten our position in the kingdom? We are not your servants nor do we owe you anything. The Ascending Dragon Sect will not accept such disrespect!" Madame Xue roared, releasing her aura without restraint.
Both the king and the crown prince fell to their knees.
She didn’t care about the possible problems this action could cause. That was a problem for the sect leader to solve.
Her only responsibility there was to ensure that the disciples were safe and well.
"You... insolent whore!" The king shouted as two experts landed beside him.
Those were the two Burning Blood Realm masters who served the royal family. Their eyes gave off a powerful murderous intent as they protected their monarch.
"Cripple that bitch, don’t let any disciples of the sect get out of-" The king’s words suddenly died away.
"I think I’ve seen enough." A dignified, serene male voice rang out across the arena.
The spectators, who could barely breathe, were forced to their knees.
"N-ninth stage of the Burning Blood Realm?" One of the experts at the king’s side spoke, his voice trembling as he was forced to retreat.
The kingdom had two experts from the Burning Blood Realm, but they were only at the fifth and sixth stage.
Raising their eyes, they saw a figure standing on a flying sword.
His red mantle covered in golden dragons fluttered as he stared coldly at the king.
"Sect leader!" Madame Xue was unable to hide the relief on her face.
That was Long Jinhai, leader of the Ascending Dragon Sect and recognized as the most powerful expert in the entire outer region of the Nine Peaks Basin.

Not only was he an experienced sword master from the peak of the Burning Blood Realm, but he even had an awakened draconic lineage and an ancestral sword that many said was invincible, even in the Nine Peaks Basin.
"My disciples have made their decision. We of the older generation have no right to judge love between young people."
The sect leader spoke, his eyes focusing on the old man who called himself the crown prince.
"Especially handing over a young woman with infinite talent and potential to an old bag of bones who is already about to die."
"I-I have other children!"
"Did i asked if you had?" Jinhai said, signaling for the king to stand up.
"Let’s forget about that. It’s not in the Ascending Dragon Sect’s interest to interfere in the kingdom’s affairs and plunge us into a new civil war."
The king bowed his head. He could have easily settled it as a diplomatic matter if the leader of the Ascending Dragon Sect hadn’t been there.
After taking that woman and killing that insolent bastard, all he would need to do was pay some money as an apology and the matter would be settled.
But with Jinhai here, he was sure that acting without thinking would only result in real blood being spilled.
The Ascending Dragon Sect had replaced a royal family before. That’s how he became king, and he knew full well that they wouldn’t hesitate to replace another.
He exhaled, calming his mind before standing up, trying to regain some of his dignity.
"I beg your pardon, senior brother Jinhai, I’ve lost control of my emotions."
"It’s okay, let’s forget about it and have some wine. I believe you’ve received a new shipment from the Nine Peaks Basin, right?" Jinhai smiled before turning his face to Hua Feiyan.
The beauty stared at him coldly.
She still remembered the fact that he had done nothing to help Qingyi, even when the Nine Peaks Basin expert had warned him that Qingyi would die.
He just shook his head in response. He didn’t want to and wouldn’t explain himself.
"Finish everything you have to do here and go back to the sect," he said, his eyes focusing on Qingyi.
"Your ceremony to become an inner disciple was delayed, but you can already try to become a core disciple if you’re interested. Elder Tian will give you suitable rewards when you return to the sect.
Jinhai turned around, ready to leave.
"Wait!" Qingyi called out, stopping him.
"My wife hasn’t received her reward yet. She won and His Majesty already has the pill for his son. I believe it’s only natural that she receives what she deserves."
Qingyi spoke, his eyes focusing on the great alchemy furnace.

"No, I stayed with my wife all night." Qingyi replied calmly.

There was nothing. The handsome young man maintained a gentle smile and calm eyes, not even a single trace of guilt coloring his face.

"Good, you can investigate elsewhere." She said, waving for the guards to leave. "Now leave, I have things to settle with my sect’s disciple.
"But elder, the king’s orders-" Kangrui tried to question, but receiving a cold stare from the woman, he turned and left.

"No, I came here for you, actually."
"For me?" Qingyi couldn’t help raising an eyebrow in confusion.
"Yes," she nodded, observing her surroundings for a brief moment before releasing her Qi, sealing off the corridor.

"She just healed me, studied my body for a few days and then released me. I ended up in a place called the Heavenly Thunder Realm and entered a secret realm, I had a few fortuitous encounters there which ended up greatly increasing my cultivation and talent."
"Heavenly Thunder Realm?" Madame Xue frowned. "Why would an expert take you to such an isolated place instead of the Nine Peaks Basin if she was interested on you?"
"I’m sorry, elder, but I’m just a junior who doesn’t know what goes on in the heads of true masters."
Hearing those words, Madame Xue sighed heavily.
Qingyi wasn’t wrong, not even she was capable of understanding the powerful cultivators of the Nine Peaks Basin.
"Wake up Feiyan, we’re leaving in a few hours. The sect leader will be accompanying us, so don’t be late."
Madame Xue turned around, she didn’t have much more to ask Qingyi.

Madame Xue gritted her teeth, the Qi around her boiling before she calmed down.
"You did well to report it to me. Don’t say anything to anyone else." Madame Xue put the pills away before walking away, leaving Qingyi alone again.

"Madame Xue has already left. The guards were probably suspicious of me."

"But why would they suspect you?-" Feiyan’s eyes twitched and her face took on a suspicious expression. "Husband... I remember you leaving the bed for a few minutes during the night. What have you done?"
"Absolutely nothing!" Qingyi answered her with an honest smile before kissing her.
"And we believe you, of course!" Ruxue laughed before returning to the heaven-defying thunder sword.

The three of them left the hotel soon after, eating in one of the capital’s many restaurants before finally heading to the sect’s meeting point, where dozens of disciples and a few elders were already waiting.

But he still preferred to go by carriage, accompanying his disciples.
Qingyi went with Feiyan to the central disciples’ carriages, but was stopped by the powerful voice of the sect leader.
"Long Qingyi, you’re coming with me."
