chapters.title: Chapter 128 - Greedy Man
paragraphs: Qingyi sat nervously in the large, luxurious carriage. Normally, this carriage was reserved for all the elders, but the sect leader had taken it so that they could have some privacy.
The leader ignored the handsome young man’s nervousness, his serene eyes focused on the passing landscape as the carriage began to move and the capital fell behind.
"Are you sure killing the crown prince was necessary?" The words broke the silence, sending a shiver down Qingyi’s spine.
"The sect leader must be mistaken, I was in my-"
"I don’t judge you," Jinhai shook his head, smiling. "I’ve killed for a woman before, I would have done the same in your place. That’s not what I want to talk about."
"Madame Xue told me about your encounters in the Heavenly Thunder Realm. Did you ever fight directly against cultivators who used this demonic pill?"
After hesitating for a moment, Qingyi nodded. "I fought one of them. The pill seems to increase power by two or three stages of cultivation in exchange for terrible damage to the body and meridians."

"Yes, this plague used to exist only in the nine peaks basin, but the demon cult is extending its tentacles to us. First only in criminal groups, but now we’ve already arrested dozens of disciples with these cursed drugs."
"I understand the sect leader’s concerns, but I’m just a humble disciple. May I ask why you tell me these things?"
"A disciple capable of reaching the Golden Core realm before the age of twenty can hardly be called humble." A soft laugh escaped Jinhai’s lips before his expression turned serious again.

"As soon as you arrive at the sect, go to the recruitment hall. Elder Tian will take care of elevating you to the position of inner disciple and will reward you for what you’ve brought from the Heavenly Thunder Realm. After that, I have a mission for you."
"A mission? What does the sect leader need?" Qingyi asked, confused.
"I believe you already know about elder Xu Qingxue, right?"
"Yes, they say she’s the best sword master in the entire outer region of the Blue Moon Continent. Well, the second best in fact, behind only the sect leader," Qingyi nodded.
"I’m the strongest, but she’s the best." Jinhai shook his head.
"She’s the only elder in the sect without a direct disciple and in about a year, the Scarlet Dragon Competition will take place between the three great sects.

This competition is only for direct disciples and their masters, but Elder Qingxue should start looking for a disciple soon as one of the possible rewards for the competition is essential cultivation material for her to advance to the Burning Blood Realm.
You must become her disciple and take part in this competition."
"Sect leader, that’s..." Qingyi hesitated.
Of all the elders, did it have to be Xu Tianming’s sister?
He had been the main cause of her brother’s death, even if he hadn’t carried out the act himself.
He knew that she had no attachment to the Xu family, to the point of gouging out her own brother’s eye, but he also knew that family ties were much more complex than that.
Who knew what that woman could carry in her heart?
"I’m well aware of your problems with her brother. Don’t worry, she’s not that kind of woman, especially after the crimes he committed." The sect leader said, sensing Qingyi’s thoughts.
"I won’t let the leader down!" Qingyi clenched his fists, bowing respectfully.
"I know you won’t, hahaha!" The leader’s laughter echoed through the carriage before he waved his hand.
"You may return to the embrace of your beloved. This old man will no longer disturb you with his affairs."
"Thank you, sect leader." Qingyi bowed one last time before getting out of the carriage and sighing with relief.
It wasn’t hot, but he was drenched in sweat.
Even with the leader suppressing his Qi to the maximum, the presence of a cultivator of that level was still hard to bear.
Qingyi returned to the carriage where Feiyan was sitting next to her master.
"Husband? What did the leader want?" The tanned beauty’s eyes sparkled as Qingyi entered and sat down next to her.
"Nothing much. He wants me to take part in the Scarlet Dragon Competition between the three great sects in a year’s time."

"Scarlet dragon competition? But that’s only for core disciples of the peak of the golden core! Even I won’t take part!" Feiyan shuddered, grabbing Qingyi’s hand and pulling it against her voluptuous chest.
"Husband... do you really have to do that? You’ve already put yourself in too much danger, I don’t want to lose you again.
"Don’t worry. The competition takes place in a secret realm where masters and disciples participate together, right?
I’ll be with Elder Qingxue, I doubt we’ll encounter any danger she can’t handle."
"Elder Qingxue? Do you want to become her disciple?"
"Yes, the leader instructed me to try to be accepted by her," Qingyi nodded. "Why? Do you know her?"
"No, I’ve only heard rumors about her beauty. The husband is certainly a greedy man." She looked away, visibly annoyed.
"What do you mean, a greedy man? These are instructions from the sect leader, I’m not going after her-"
"Ahem," Madame Xue cleared her throat, reminding the young couple of her presence.
The two soon calmed down and the journey continued peacefully.
During this time, Qingyi took the opportunity to ask about the icy flower he had found in the tunnels, but neither of them knew exactly what it was.
Madame Xue only knew that it was a flower imbued with deep ice Qi, a very special type whose existence was rare, even in the immortal heaven.
She offered a great fortune to buy it, but Qingyi followed the system’s advice and preferred to keep it with him.
After a few weeks of traveling, they finally arrived at the sect.
Qingyi immediately accompanied Feiyan to her residence.
He had collected many treasures that would be useless to him, but which would certainly help with her alchemy training.
It was time to spoil her with some gifts before taking her to meet the priestesses.

It was a very good item that should save Qingyi a lot of lust points. But the moment he read the description, he lost all interest in the pill.
It was totally useless to him.
"Elder, would it be possible to exchange the pill for more contribution points?"
"Well, yes..." The elder’s eyes were filled with confusion.

"But why would I do that? This pill is a once-in-a-lifetime chance. Many inner disciples, even core disciples would kill to have it. In the entire outer region of the Blue Moon Continent, only we make it."
"I understand the elder’s concerns, but I very much doubt that this pill will benefit me more than the sect’s contribution points."
"Ugh..." Elder Tian massaged his temples, feeling a slight headache coming on.
Why did Qingyi have to be so stubborn?
In the end, he just shook his head.
"Very well." The elder put the pill away, depositing the equivalent of another three hundred thousand contribution points into Qingyi’s token.
Seeing that amount, Qingyi couldn’t help but smile slightly.
It was exactly what he needed, money to buy cultivation pills and advance without having to spend lust points building a cultivation base!
"If that’s all, I’ll take my leave now, elder." Qingyi bowed and prepared to leave.
"Wait!" Elder Tian stopped him. "I had promised to let you attend my lessons with my daughter. I haven’t fulfilled that promise yet.
My working hours here are already ending, and today’s lesson may be important, especially for you who want to become Elder Xu Qingxue’s disciple."
Those words made Qingyi’s eyes light up. He had totally forgotten about that proposal.
If Elder Tian was so excited about the idea of helping him in his mission to collect more and more Lust Points, how could Qingyi ignore him?
"Honey, come and greet Long Qingyi!" The elder called out, and Qingyi waited anxiously.
He had expected a youthful, slender beauty with huge breasts.
But that’s not what graced him.
In reality, what he heard were heavy footsteps slowly approaching.
A colossal figure entered Elder Tian’s office, with a round, sagging and wrinkled face, a fat belly and arms as wide as Qingyi’s torso.
"Isn’t she the most beautiful thing in the world? She looks just like her mother!" The elder spoke proudly, not noticing the gloomy expression on Qingyi’s face.
’Most beautiful thing in the world? Is that even a woman?" Qingyi wondered.
He didn’t even want to use the system to see her status points, slowly walking away.
"I’m sorry, elder, but I have to organize things at my new residence." Qingyi sneaked away.
A relieved sigh escaped Qingyi’s lips as he fled, leaving a confused Elder Tian behind.
Qingyi headed straight for the inner disciples’ pavilion area.
Many eyes fell on him as he passed through the streets and slowly climbed the mountainside.
But no one dared to do anything.
Everyone already knew his name, Long Qingyi, an unprecedented talent that had attracted the attention of even an expert from the Nine Peaks Basin.
Even the most arrogant of young masters preferred to avoid him.
"You seem quite happy with the fear you cause in them." Ruxue’s sensual and mature voice echoed in Qingyi’s mind.
His hand went down to the handle of the heaven-defying thunder sword, gently caressing it.
Of course he was happy.
He had walked at least a few kilometers and hadn’t met a single arrogant young master begging for the steel of his sword!

chapters.title: Chapter 133 - Elder Xu Qingxue
paragraphs: Qingyi stopped in front of one of the pavilions. He checked the number on his disciple token and confirmed that he was in the right place.
He pressed the token against the gate. A faint click echoed before it opened, revealing the interior.
It was infinitely smaller than Feiyan’s place, but still three or four times larger than the one he had received as the holder of the golden token.
Not only that, it also had a fifty-fold cultivation room, one of the best available for free in the sect, second only to those of the core disciples.
Qingyi entered his new residence.
His eyes passed by the cultivation room, but he ignored it, heading straight for his bedroom, where he let his tired body collapse onto the soft bed.
For a brief moment, he closed his eyes.
He thought about looking for Feiyan, but decided to take a short nap first, his mind soon being claimed by sleep.
Qingyi only woke up to hear soft knocks on his door.
With a grunt, he got up and walked down to the living room before opening the door. On the other side, a middle-aged, ordinary-looking woman was waiting for him.
"Greetings, young master Qingyi." The woman bowed respectfully. "I’ve been sent by the sect leader."
"What does the sect leader want?"
"Elder Xu Qingxue has announced that she will start selecting external disciples tomorrow morning. The sect leader will be extremely disappointed if you don’t take part."
Without giving Qingyi time to reply, she turned and left immediately.
"Ah..." He sighed.
He had really expected it to take a little longer for him to get stronger, but that was fine.
He doubted that he would find anyone powerful enough to challenge him among the inner disciples.
’Better safe than sorry...’ he thought, remembering his fight against Tianming. He didn’t want anything like that to happen again.
After that, Qingyi went straight to his cultivation chamber.
He only had a few cultivation pills with him, but he had to make them count. He closed his eyes and swallowed the first one, starting to cultivate.
Qingyi felt the Qi of the pill run through his meridians as it dissolved in his stomach. Slowly, he guided it towards his Dantian and then towards the golden Qi core.
It didn’t take long to consume more than ten pills. His Qi core was slowly stabilizing while his level of comprehension increased considerably.
Feeling ready, he opened his status screen and clicked on improve cultivation.
[Initiating advancement to the sixth stage of the Golden Core Realm]
His body was immediately seized by a sharp pain and his muscles stiffened as they were slowly rebuilt, but this sensation didn’t last long, soon replaced by a pleasant freshness.
[Your cultivation has increased! Fifth stage of the Golden Core Realm → sixth stage of the Golden Core Realm].
He really wished that all the advances in his cultivation level were as smooth as this, but knowing the system, that was too much to ask.
When Qingyi finally left his cultivation chamber, it was early morning. His ears were filled with the soft chirping of birds as he stretched.
His eyes immediately turned to his status screen.
[Name: Long Qingyi Age: 19
Cultivation: Sixth stage of the golden core realm (3200 lust points to upgrade)
Affinities: Lightning 98 - Sword: 97 - Charm: 1000 (can be upgraded in the lust store)
Spiritual roots: Mid-level lightning sword root (100,000 lust points to upgrade, new roots can be bought in the lust store)
Bloodline: Blood of the Corruption Dragon God (Epic grade, 500,000 lust points to upgrade)
Constitution: Body of the primordial dragon (Epic grade, 500,000 lust points to upgrade) Lust points: 19.717]
He still had enough to make a few more advances, but he decided to control himself and save those lust points in case they were needed for an emergency.
Qingyi took a quick shower, put on the three-bladed monarch’s set and finally left.
The inner disciples’ arena had been closed.
Its stands were empty, but on the large marble platform, dozens of sword cultivating inner disciples could be seen.
Most were only at the first stage of the golden core realm, with only one at the second stage.
’Ah... I guess I really have grown beyond my position in the sect...’ Qingyi sighed as he entered the arena.
It even seemed a little unfair that he should be competing against those weaklings.
His eyes swept over the disciples and then focused on a lone figure.
It was a tall woman. Her long silver hair fell over her delicate shoulders, a few wild locks subtly covering one of her beautiful, cold blue eyes.
Her skin was fair and perfect, perhaps even whiter than Ruxue’s skin, as if the purest snow had been used to paint it.
Her black dress, covered in silver details, showed off a sensual neckline and long, slender legs. In her left hand she carried a black sword and in her right, a white sword.
Her beautiful face had a cold, uninterested expression, as if the young cultivators in front of her didn’t even exist.
That was Xu Qingxue.

With a two-tone spirit root of sword and wind, she was recognized as the most skilled sword master in the entire outer region of the Blue Moon Continent and an incomparable beauty, despite being cold and distant.
Qingyi knew well the stories about the many broken hearts of powerful experts who had tried to conquer her.
None had ever gotten more than two sentences out of her.
Now, observing her, he had to admit: the rumours about her beauty were no exaggeration.
[Name: Xu Qingxue
Age: 73
Corruption: 0/100
Chastity: Intact
Lust: 0%
Talent: Genius
Reward: Extremely high
Cultivation: ninth stage of the Iron Body realm
Spiritual roots: low-level two- coloured spiritual root (Sword and Wind)
Lineage: None
Constitution: None
Traits: Faithful, sword fanatic, cold, distant, repressed desires].

’As expected of a woman of her level...’ Qingyi gasped inwardly, but before he could study her further, his attention was stolen by a young man of little beauty at the second stage of the Golden Core realm.
"Elder Qingxue, no selection is necessary!" The young man spoke out loud. "I don’t even have to move a finger to defeat these vermin!"
Qingxue looked up, observing the arrogant young man. She didn’t reply immediately, her face remaining cold and inexpressive as her piercing blue eyes studied him.
"Go on." She broke the silence, her voice harmonious and soft, like a freezing but strangely pleasant breeze.
"I won’t let you down, elder!" The young man roared, looking for the weakest of the challengers.
His eyes soon fell on Qingyi and he smiled, not even bothering to try to sense the handsome young man’s cultivation.
In his mind, he had just found the perfect prey.
[Xu Qingxue’s art on the character tab! vote for you favorite girl there]

chapters.title: Chapter 134 - you’ll hurt yourself
paragraphs: "He’s going after...?" One of the inner disciples opened his mouth, his eyes wide as he watched the arrogant young man approach Qingyi.
"Shhhh, let him try, I’ll want to see that!" Another whispered.
Everyone there had heard of Qingyi’s achievements. Everyone except that poor fellow, apparently.
The arrogant young man approached Qingyi in confident strides, placing his hands on the handsome young man’s shoulders.
"Fall to your knees, before I have to break them." He growled, unleashing his full Qi of the second stage of the Golden Core realm, forcing even the distant cultivators to retreat.
The marble under Qingyi’s feet cracked, resisting for a brief moment before breaking, causing the handsome young man to sink to his heels.
But despite all that power, Qingyi didn’t even flinch.
His face held a gentle, humorous smile, with no trace of offense in his beautiful, piercing black eyes.
It didn’t take long for the arrogant young man to realize his mistake and hastily try to retreat. Unfortunately, it was already too late.
Qingyi moved his hands, grabbing both of his opponent’s wrists. Without giving the young man time to react, he strengthened the grip of his fists.
A heartbreaking scream echoed as the arrogant young man’s bones were crushed in loud, despairing cracks.
Qingyi didn’t even use his Qi, it wasn’t necessary. Only his brute physical strength was enough to deal with those insects.
"Argh... FUCK! MY HANDS!" The arrogant young man whimpered, falling to his knees.

"I only broke the bones, I didn’t destroy any of your meridians. It should be completely healed in a few days with a good healing pill." Qingyi patted the young man on the back, whose watery eyes filled with terror.
With what little strength he had in his legs, he ran, retreating from the arena.
Watching the young man’s back move away, Qingyi shifted his gaze to Elder Xu Qingxue.
He noticed her plump rosy lips curving into a subtle smile, lasting just over a second before she suppressed it.
"The others, you may leave," she said, her eyes fixed on Qingyi’s.
"But elder, we haven’t even taken part in your test yet!" one of the disciples complained, shrinking under the silver-haired beauty’s cold gaze.
"It’s not necessary." She shook her head, taking a step towards Qingyi.
The other inner disciples hesitated, but in the end just bowed and withdrew. The moment that monster had gotten there, they had all lost.
At least they wouldn’t be going home with some broken bones.
After a few moments, Qingyi and Qingxue finally found themselves alone, her long silver hair fluttering in the gentle breeze.
"Long Qingyi greets elder Xu Qingxue!" Qingyi bowed, clasping his fists respectfully.
After a moment of silence, Qingxue asked: "Did the sect leader instruct you to become my direct disciple?"
Qingyi couldn’t help but hesitate at that question. Was that a good thing or a bad thing?
"Yes, elder, I was instructed by the sect leader to become your disciple and take part in the scarlet dragon competition with you." He decided to be honest.
"Mmm~~" Qingxue exhaled softly as she took another step towards him.
Soon, they were face to face, her warm, sweet breath invading Qingyi’s nostrils as she studied him.
"Draw your sword," she moved away, turning her back on Qingyi.
The handsome young man’s eyes focused on her shapely hips as she walked away, swaying gently with each step.
"I will test your blade. If it’s worthy, you’ll be my disciple. If not, I believe you should report your failure to the sect leader."
She turned, her double swords sliding out of their sheaths with loud, sharp whistles.

Her Qi exploded, her dress fluttering as her body was covered in wind Qi, the fabric rising and revealing a brief glimpse of her white panties sinking into the rift between the fat, fluffy mounds of her virgin femininity.
Qingyi couldn’t help but shudder at the sight, feeling his dragon awaken.
If he had the courage, he would certainly thank her for allowing him to see such a beautiful scenery.
"I won’t disappoint the elder!" Qingyi bowed one last time, controlling his thoughts and focusing his mind.
"Ugh... poor thing, one more to fall into the hands of that damned womanizer!" Ruxue’s voice sounded in Qingyi’s mind, her sweet, seductive laugh echoing in his head.
Qingyi ignored her, drawing the heaven-defying thunder sword.
His lightning sword Qi immediately took over the blade, shining brightly, with electric sparks exploding from it and making the air around him boil.
Qingxue couldn’t hide a flash of surprise on her beautiful, delicate face, but it didn’t last long.
"Come," she ordered.
Qingyi activated the lightning steps, his body exploding in speed as he used the first form of the Stormy Monarch sword art.
Qingxue didn’t even move, just casually raising her sword.
A loud clang echoed and Qingyi immediately regretted having made a frontal advance. It was like hitting a wall of cast steel, a painful tremor spreading through his arms.
"It’s not bad," Qingxue’s serene, cold voice hit Qingyi’s eardrums and he tried to back away, but it was too late.
She raised her right leg, her foot hitting Qingyi’s chest with a thud.

The handsome young man was thrown backwards, bouncing on the ground and being forced to drive the heaven-defying thunder sword into the ground, tearing through it for almost a hundred meters before finally coming to a stop.
Luckily, his constitution was extremely powerful; if it had been up to his strength alone, he would surely have broken all his ribs.
His eyes rose, watching Qingxue, whose leg was still raised.
Her dress slid down smoothly, revealing even more of the pale, smooth, perfect skin of her thick, luscious thighs, a thin trickle of sweat running down between them.
It was a beautiful sight, but Qingyi couldn’t enjoy it for long.
Qingxue was already upon him, her sword flying towards his neck at an absurd speed.
"Use all your power, you’ll hurt yourself if you keep holding back."

"Yes, master," Qingyi nodded.
"Good... A mission was recently issued by the sect protection pavilion. You will complete it together with three other core disciples. Hua Juechen will lead the mission."
"Juechen? You mean the sect leader’s disciple?" Qingyi raised his head.
He had seen the sect leader’s disciple from afar and, although he didn’t know how powerful he was, he knew well that he was not a figure to be underestimated.
"Yes," Qingxue removed a small talisman from her spatial ring and tossed it to Qingyi.
"This carries a thread of my Qi. Use it if necessary. Meet Hua Juechen at the sect’s mission pavilion. He should be waiting for you there by now."
Qingyi took the talisman, looking at it for a brief moment before putting it away and bowing to his master one last time.
"Thank you, master. I won’t disappoint you!"
Immediately afterwards, he walked away, leaving her alone again.
"I know you won’t," she whispered, a soft smile playing on her lips before she suppressed it, realizing she was blushing.
Her thoughts were drifting again. She needed to cultivate and calm her heart.
Qingyi crossed the sect quickly, his eyes studying the people passing by with curiosity before focusing on an imposing figure.
It was a man in simple robes, his body over two meters tall towering above everyone there and his brutish face bearing an honest smile.
Next to him were young men of less eye-catching appearance.
One of them was an ordinary man with long black hair and an inexpressive face, while the other was a man of little beauty whose face seemed strangely familiar to Qingyi.
The man of little beauty turned towards him, his facial expression immediately distorting.
"Are you the damn pretty face who attacked my brother?" he roared, approaching in strides.
His cultivation at the peak of the Golden Core realm exploded, but it barely affected Qingyi.
"So that’s where I recognized that face from." Qingyi thought, they were two brothers truly blessed with everything but beauty and personality.
"I, Tang Ruhu, will have my revenge!" The ugly man declared, but stopped when he felt a powerful hand fall on his shoulder, squeezing hard enough to make him let out a grunt of pain.
"You can deal with your personal tantrums later. For now, let’s focus on the mission. Of course, we can complete it with one less man if you wish."
Those words made Ruhu shudder.
He knew full well that it wasn’t Long Qingyi who was being threatened, it was he himself.
"N-not at all, Senior Brother Juechen. I was just testing Junior Brother Qingyi, hehehehe," Ruhu smiled awkwardly.
"Good!" Juechen returned the smile, turning to Qingyi.
"It’s a pleasure to meet you, Junior Brother Qingyi. I’m Hua Juechen, disciple of the sect leader." Juechen spoke, shifting his gaze to the man of little beauty.
"This is Tang Ruhu, disciple of the internal affairs elder."
He turned, pointing at the ordinary-looking man. "That’s Xu Hantao, disciple of the war hall elder."
"Long Qingyi greets the senior brothers," Qingyi bowed, his face a little surprised at Juechen’s way of acting.
He had heard of his honest and straightforward personality, but he hadn’t expected it to be so much.
"There’s no need to be so decorous. Just call us by our names. A talent like you deserves it," Juechen slapped Qingyi hard on the back as his smile widened.
"Then I’ll follow big brother Juechen," Qingyi smiled back. Juechen’s honest personality was by no means unpleasant.
"Perfect! We’re leaving right now. We should be there in less than two weeks," Juechen said, ignoring the curious looks from the external disciples as they left.
"What will the mission be, exactly?" Qingyi asked, but Juechen was interrupted before he could answer.
"Husband!" The drawling, seductive voice of a voluptuous, tanned beauty played in Qingyi’s ears.
He turned around and was greeted by a huge pair of breasts hitting his chest while thick, creamy thighs wrapped around his waist in a tight embrace.
Without hesitation, Feiyan pushed her lips against his, their tongues meeting as his hands gripped her hips, searching for support.

"The master told me about you leaving. Were you really going on this dangerous mission without even letting your wives know?" she whispered, the looks of envy and judgment around them not affecting her at all.
"I’m sorry, dear... I only found out about the urgency of the mission now. My master sent me off immediately."
"That’s a terrible excuse!" She puffed out her cheeks before pulling a small pouch out of her space ring and handing it to Qingyi.

chapters.title: Chapter 141 - So... who’s next?
paragraphs: "This is?" Qingyi’s eyes lit up when he saw at least fifty cultivation and healing pills inside the pouch.
Even the lowest quality ones were at least 77% pure, with some approaching 85%.
"I spent the weekend working on them to help husband..."
"Ah... do I deserve such a good wife?" Qingyi asked, resisting the urge to slap Feiyan’s fat, juicy ass.
"I promise to reward you well after I get back, take good care of the girls at the temple." He smiled at her, his gaze full of affection.
"I will, husband." She replied, blushing.
After exchanging one last passionate kiss, Feiyan left, and Qingyi turned to the other three core disciples, whose eyes were filled with envy.
Juechen and Huntao seemed deeply impressed by their junior brother’s abilities while Ruhu was biting himself with rage.
"Junior brother Qingyi really doesn’t give us a chance to compete, neither in talent nor in love." Juechen shook his head, drawing an awkward smile from Qingyi.
"Let’s go." Juechen spoke and the group followed him out of the city of golden clouds, where they got into a large, luxurious carriage.
"So, Senior Brother Juechen, what will our mission be?" Qingyi asked again, drawing curious looks from Ruhu and Huntao as well.
None of them knew exactly what that mission was, only Juechen.
"We’ll have to deal with the demon cult, the bastards seem to be kidnapping children for some cursed ritual." Juechen spoke, his eyes shining with murderous intent.
"We’ll go to the north of the kingdom, we must save the children and kill every last one of those bastards, if possible take one or two as prisoners."
’Demon cult... those sons of bitches again. Qingyi gritted his teeth.
He didn’t really care what they did, but if these things had the slightest chance of hurting his wives, he had to get rid of them as soon as possible.
"Those damned things exist everywhere, although in the heavenly heavens, they’re an even bigger problem since real demons exist there."
Ruxue’s sweet voice entered his head.
"Have you ever killed real demons?" Qingyi asked.
"Countless, there are seventy-two demon kings, I’ve beheaded five of the bastards." Ruxue laughed proudly before her expression faded.
"Unfortunately, they’re like immortal plagues, you cut off one head, another is born in its place."
"I see, there’s nothing to do but keep killing them forever." With a grunt, Qingyi shook his head, looking out at the landscape past the carriage door.
He was a little anxious to test the power of the third form of the Tempest Monarch’s sword art, and some unorthodox cultivators would be the perfect target.
The journey lasted around twelve days, the scenery around them slowly changing from vibrant forests to yellowish tundras before finally being taken over by snow.
This was the northern region of the Golden Sun Realm, one of the most inhospitable places on the continent, where beasts from the Golden Core Realm and even the Iron Body Realm prowled.
Their carriage followed a clumsy path towards a village where they would spend the night.
"Young master Juechen, there seems to be something wrong in the village." The coachman spoke, his voice a little shaky as he stopped the carriage.
The four core disciples quickly stepped out of the carriage, casting suspicious glances in the direction of the village.
It was completely empty, snow piling up on the high wooden palisades while its wide double gates stood half open, a bloodstain on the sign that bore the name: Icy Grass Village.
They exchanged glances before entering the village.
The inside was as desolate as the outside, collapsed houses still burning with flames and the snow white, marked by fresh blood.
Qingyi knelt down, running his fingers through one of the bloodstains, his eyes twitching.
"It’s demonic Qi." He warned, taking a step back.
At that moment, a heartbreaking scream rang out, making everyone’s blood run cold.
"The coachman!" Juechan shouted as he turned around, but all he saw was a decapitated corpse.
Dozens of powerful auras appeared around them, all exuding the disgusting smell of demonic Qi.
The weakest was at the seventh stage of the Golden Core realm, the most powerful just one step away from the Iron Body realm.
"Brothers, it looks like we’re going to have a feast today! Look how many incomparable talents!" The most powerful figure roared, drawing scornful laughter from those behind him.
"Who the hell are you? How dare you hurt the people of the Golden Sun Kingdom?" Huntao growled, his sword glowing with fiery Qi.
"We are the ones who-" The figure’s words were interrupted by Juechen’s great sword hitting his jaw and throwing him backwards like a cannonball.
He didn’t even draw it, his face contorted with hatred.
"You will die in pain!" Juechen roared.
"F-fuck! What are you waiting for, kill these bastards!" The figure ordered, a few teeth falling out of his mouth.
He barely managed to get up before Juechen was above him again.
Qingyi drew the Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword, his lightning Qi exploding as he was surrounded by five demonic cultivators.
A crash echoed as he defended himself, his body being thrown through more than five houses, his back breaking through wooden walls before he finally came to a stop, crashing into a stone wall.
He could, of course, kill any of those fuckers with a single blow, but he wanted to play with them a bit first.
"Die pretty face!" one of the demonic cultivators roared, launching several throwing knives surrounded by demonic Qi towards Qingyi at a frightening speed.
The handsome young man released his Qi, a subtle smile playing on his lips as he used his draconic eyes and easily parried all the knives.
"What? H-how?" The demon cultivator’s eyes widened.
He barely had time to react before he felt his vision spinning, catching a brief glimpse of his own decapitated body.
"So... who’s next?" Qingyi smiled and the other four took a step back.
They had gone for Qingyi because they thought he was the weakest, but now they weren’t so sure.

chapters.title: Chapter 142 - I’ve seen it happen.
paragraphs: "Fuck, he’s only one, let’s attack together!" One of the demonic cultivators shouted, exchanging glances with his three companions.
After a moment’s hesitation, they advanced, their demonic Qi destroying everything in front of them.
Qingyi closed his eyes for a brief moment, feeling the air around him.
His eyes suddenly opened, glowing a deep purple as he used the first form of the Stormy Monarch sword art.
All the demon cultivators saw was a flash of light.
Qingyi’s blade became a blur as one of them fell, his chest pierced by a deep, bloody hole.
They barely had time to react when the handsome young man’s thrust turned into a horizontal slash.
A powerful blade of Qi flowed towards them with frightening power.
They raised their swords, roared and tried to defend themselves, but to no avail.
Their blades fell to the ground, split in two by a slash of molten metal.
Their bodies followed soon after as bloody slashes appeared on their abdomens, cutting them in half.
Qingyi barely paid any attention to the torn bodies, smiling softly at his new power.
Those five were at the peak of the Golden Core realm, but he finished them off in just three moves without even fighting at full strength.
Before, at the very least he would have had to sweat a bit to deal with opponents of this level, but after a single day of being trained by his master, everything had changed.
His skills were much more powerful and his blade infinitely sharper.
Having a master who truly taught him how to fight instead of simply repeating nonsense about purity and celibacy was truly incredible.
With a sigh, he leapt above the house, watching the other battles.
Juechen was still standing over the one who seemed to be the leader of the group. The white scabbard of his sword was blood red.
He hadn’t even drawn the blade, using only the hard leather to defeat his opponent.
"Argh! You bastard, my master won’t let you get away with this!" The leader of the group whimpered, opening his mouth and trying to bite a small bag of poison between his teeth.
Juechen didn’t allow him to commit suicide, plunging the tip of his sword into the demon cultivator’s mouth, muffling his cries of pain.
"Ah..." Juechen pressed his finger into the man’s neck, knocking him out before standing up.
"Junior Brother Qingyi, are you finished?" He smiled at the handsome young man.
"Yes, senior brother." Qingyi turned his face, staring at the other two who were still fighting their own battles.
"Should we help them?"
"No. Cultivators of noble origin have fragile pride. Hurting that pride is not a good idea." Juechen shook his head, putting a question mark on Qingyi’s face.
"Senior Brother Juechen isn’t of noble origin?" Qingyi asked, surprised.
Of course, there were commoner cultivators among the core disciples, but they were rare.
Apart from him and Feiyan, he doubted there were more than one or two. Such positions of power were almost always monopolized by noble houses.
"Not at all. I was plowing the land like a bull to survive when the master spotted me during one of his trips and asked me if I was interested in farming."
"I can’t believe I almost turned him down then, hahaha!" Juechen laughed, but Qingyi could see a hint of melancholy in his eyes.
They just watched in silence as Huntao and Ruhu ended their battles, observing Qingyi with a strange look.
Although the handsome young man had shown all his power to Qingxue, he was still suppressing his cultivation with the three-bladed monarch set and none of them knew of his true power.
How had a cultivator of the third stage of the Golden Core realm managed to end his battle before them, cultivators of the ninth stage of the Golden Core realm?
Qingyi sounded even more absurd than the rumors said.
"What kind of artifact did you use to finish off your opponents so quickly? You should have saved it for a real battle, not for those wimps!" Ruhu growled angrily.

"I can show you, if you like, but I very much doubt that your mommy will appreciate having to take care of two children with broken hands." Qingyi smiled coldly, his grip on the heaven-defying thunder sword growing stronger.
"You damn pretty face!
"Enough!" Juechen interrupted them, throwing the unconscious demon cultivator over his shoulder.
" We’re going straight to the Ice Flower City. People are dying right now. You can have an official duel to settle your differences when you get to the sect."
"Ugh... lucky bastard!" Ruhu threw another menacing glance in Qingyi’s direction as he turned around.
The handsome young man just shook his head, unable to hide a thin thread of murderous light in his eyes.
He was familiar with this type of person and knew that Ruhu would probably try to do something stupid.
’Ah... I’ll just keep my guard up for now.’ Qingyi decided in his mind before focusing on the mission again.
Soon, they found themselves walking along a narrow path.
Ruhu and Huntao stayed behind, guarding the flanks of the group while Qingyi and Juechen carried the demonic cultivator in the center.
"How much power are you hiding?" Juechen asked, breaking the silence.
"Uh? What’s senior brother talking about?" Qingyi raised an eyebrow, turning his face to the brutish man.

"You didn’t use any artifacts, I would have noticed if you had. You allowed yourself to receive that first attack to get out of our sight and fight more freely. So tell me, how much power are you hiding?"
"Ah... I’m no match for senior brother’s perception..." Qingyi scratched the back of his head.
"I’m at the sixth stage of the Golden Core Realm. Apologies for deceiving you, Senior Brother Juechen."
"No need to apologize." Juechen shook his head, a gentle smile playing on his lips.
"In reality, you’re right to hide your power.
There are already people with a lot of suspicions about the speed of your advance to the golden core realm, but that can be attributed to your encounter with the expert from the nine peaks basin.
But if they find out that after returning, you’ve already made three other advances, these suspicions could get even worse.
They might believe that you have some transcendental artifact and that this is the path to transcendence."
Juechen raised his face, observing the cloudy, pristine sky. "I’ve seen it happen."
"My master and his master may not be the kind of people to take action against their own disciples, but many... no, most of the elders of the sect are driven by nothing but greed."

Although the handsome young man had shown all his power to Qingxue, he was still suppressing his cultivation with the three-bladed monarch set and none of them knew of his true power.
How had a cultivator of the third stage of the Golden Core realm managed to end his battle before them, cultivators of the ninth stage of the Golden Core realm?
Qingyi sounded even more absurd than the rumors said.
"What kind of artifact did you use to finish off your opponents so quickly?
You should have saved it for a real battle, not for those wimps!" Ruhu growled angrily.

"I can show you, if you like, but I very much doubt that your mommy will appreciate having to take care of two children with broken hands." Qingyi smiled coldly, his grip on the heaven-defying thunder sword growing stronger.
"You damn pretty face!
"Enough!" Juechen interrupted them, throwing the unconscious demon cultivator over his shoulder.
" We’re going straight to the Ice Flower City.
People are dying right now.
You can have an official duel to settle your differences when you get to the sect."
"Ugh... lucky bastard!" Ruhu threw another menacing glance in Qingyi’s direction as he turned around.
The handsome young man just shook his head, unable to hide a thin thread of murderous light in his eyes.
He was familiar with this type of person and knew that Ruhu would probably try to do something stupid.
I’ll just keep my guard up for now.’ Qingyi decided in his mind before focusing on the mission again.
Soon, they found themselves walking along a narrow path.
Ruhu and Huntao stayed behind, guarding the flanks of the group while Qingyi and Juechen carried the demonic cultivator in the center.
"How much power are you hiding?" Juechen asked, breaking the silence.
"Uh?
What’s senior brother talking about?" Qingyi raised an eyebrow, turning his face to the brutish man.
"You didn’t use any artifacts, I would have noticed if you had.
You allowed yourself to receive that first attack to get out of our sight and fight more freely.
So tell me, how much power are you hiding?"
I’m no match for senior brother’s perception..." Qingyi scratched the back of his head.
"I’m at the sixth stage of the Golden Core Realm.
Apologies for deceiving you, Senior Brother Juechen."
"No need to apologize." Juechen shook his head, a gentle smile playing on his lips.
"In reality, you’re right to hide your power.
There are already people with a lot of suspicions about the speed of your advance to the golden core realm, but that can be attributed to your encounter with the expert from the nine peaks basin.
But if they find out that after returning, you’ve already made three other advances, these suspicions could get even worse.
They might believe that you have some transcendental artifact and that this is the path to transcendence."
Juechen raised his face, observing the cloudy, pristine sky.
"I’ve seen it happen."
"My master and his master may not be the kind of people to take action against their own disciples, but many... no, most of the elders of the sect are driven by nothing but greed."

chapters.title: Chapter 143 - Lord Zhou
paragraphs: "Thank you senior brother, I won’t forget your words," Qingyi said.
Juechen’s words came as no surprise to him.
There were always people wanting what was his, the curse of being too ’talented’.
Luckily, he had ways of defending himself.

Many commoners without powerful sponsors died long before they could blossom because they showed more than they should have and aroused the greed of those who should have been their brothers and protectors.
It was a truly pitiful world.
The rest of the journey was conducted in silence.
The Ice Flower City was no more than fifty kilometers from the village, so it didn’t take them long.
Soon they saw high gray stone walls, their snow-covered towers guarded by experts from the Foundation Realm and Golden Core Realm.
"Who’s coming?" One of the guards asked.
His high-quality armor and the symbol of a dragon on his chest revealed that he belonged to some noble house, probably a military officer.
"I am Juechen, a disciple of the leader of the Ascending Dragon Sect. We have been sent on a mission, your Lord should already be aware of it," Juechen declared, revealing his disciple token.
The officer studied the token from afar, his eyes focusing on the unconscious man on Juechen’s shoulders.
"Who is that? Why does he exude demonic energy?" The officer questioned.
"That information only concerns your lord. Open the gates," Juechen replied, a hint of irritation appearing in his voice.
The guard hesitated, but after a short moment, he finally gave in, ordering his men to allow the group to enter.
"I’ll escort you to the lord’s mansion," said the officer, jumping down from the wall and walking alongside them.
"This place looks dead..." Qingyi commented as they entered the city.
The streets were empty, with no carriages, pedestrians or vendors, just one or two lost souls watching them suspiciously.
"People are terrified of the recent attacks by unorthodox cultivators, and the guard has already suffered a lot of damage in ambushes.
We simply don’t have enough personnel to cover the entire city," the officer explained, unable to hide his frown.
"Do you have any idea how many unorthodox cultivators there are?" Huntao entered the conversation.
The officer shook his head. "No, they’ve mainly been attacking isolated groups of guards, never fighting directly.
I’d guess a few hundred at least. We’ve been waiting for weeks for reinforcements from the capital, but so far, nothing."
"I see..."
The group continued through the wide streets of the city, finally arriving at the lord’s residence.
It was a mansion whose luxury lagged far behind the exuberant residences of the capital’s elite, but it still had a charm of its own in its icy blue walls.
"Greetings young master Juechen," the servant bowed respectfully. "Lord Zhou is waiting for you. Please follow me, let’s not allow the food to get cold."
" Good, I was starving! Hahaha!" Juechen laughed as he threw the demonic cultivator to the ground.
"Throw him in the dungeon and make sure he has no way of killing himself. He’ll still have to say a lot to us."
"As you wish, young master." The servant nodded and two guards approached, grabbing the demon cultivator and taking him away.
They entered the lord’s mansion, walking through long corridors covered in portraits of ancient Zhou family heroes.
"Did you know that lightning cultivators are most often used as torturers, Junior Brother Qingyi? If you have the stomach for such things, your help would be most welcome."
"Causing pain to one of these unorthodox bastards will be a pleasure, Senior Brother Juechen," Qingyi smiled.
He had already used his skills against humans who deserved much less.
Soon, they arrived at a large, dark dining room.
It was empty, except for an old, moribund man, his aura of the peak of the Iron Body Realm already slowly fading.
’He must be at least four hundred years old...’ Qingyi sighed mentally.
Cultivators of the Iron Body Realm usually lived to be four hundred and fifty, but only began to lose their youth after three hundred and fifty, becoming old at four hundred.
To be in such a state, that man must have been just one step away from death.
Apart from Tang Yundu and Ruxue, it was the first time he had met someone that old.
"Young Master Juechen?" The man raised his aged face, stroking his gray, brittle beard.
"Lord Zhou, we heard about your problem with unorthodox cultivators. The sect has sent us to deal with him,
Juechen took a chair at the table covered in delicacies, signaling for Qingyi, Ruhu and Huntao to sit down too.
"Ah... these bastards have been terrorizing our lands for millennia! But things are different now, they’re more organized, more prepared."
Lord Zhou settled into his chair, pouring himself a glass of wine before waving his hand.
"Eat up, young men. No guest of mine will be left with an empty stomach."
"Thank you Lord Zhou," Juechen also poured himself a glass of wine and grabbed a roasted chicken thigh, stuffing it into his mouth without any decorum.
"Things have been changing in the central region of the kingdom too, we believe it’s the work of the demonic cult," Juechen said.
Lord Zhou’s gaze changed.
"Demonic cult?" He suddenly stood up, his eyes shining with murderous intent. "Those pigs dare try to hurt my people-"
Lord Zhou’s words were interrupted by a deep, bloody cough as he fell to his knees.
"My lord!" The servant held Lord Zhou. "Remember what the doctor said, you mustn’t use your Qi recklessly!"
Raising his face, the servant looked at Juechen and his group.
"Lord Zhou needs to rest. Please eat at will, I’ll take you to your quarters shortly."
The rest of the meal was silent.
The group decided that they would spend the night there and then go after information about the demon cult’s hideout.
It wasn’t long before Qingyi found himself lying on a large bed in a luxurious room, his eyes focused on the snow falling outside.
It had been a long time since he had taken the time to watch such mundane things.
"What are you thinking about?" Ruxue spoke, her voluptuous, naked body appearing next to his bed.

Without asking permission, she climbed onto the bed, her plump, perfectly round ass taking over Qingyi’s lap and as she leaned over him, her huge, soft breasts enveloped his face in a warm, pleasant embrace.
"Not much..." He sighed, his hands wrapping around her delicate waist, pulling her against him and sinking even deeper into those pale, warm and soft mountains

chapters.title: Chapter 144 - Torture
paragraphs: "Junior brother Qingyi!" A loud knock on the door woke Qingyi, who let out a grunt and looked at the voluptuous beauty sleeping peacefully in his arms.
He smiled softly as he let his hands fall on her plump, juicy ass with a loud clap, delighting in the cute squeal that escaped the woman’s lips as her soft buttocks jiggled with the impact.
"Ughn~~ you damn womanizer... if you love my ass so much, kiss it instead of spanking it!"
Ruxue stood up with a long, pained moan, caressing her burning ass.
"As you wish." Qingyi grabbed her hips and spun her around, pressing his lips against the sweet, creamy skin of her ass in a short kiss.
Lifting his gaze, he saw Ruxue’s beautiful face flushed a fiery red, her full, purple lips quivering softly.
She hadn’t expected him to actually do that.
Hiding her blushing face, she fled towards the heaven-defying thunder sword.
Qingyi just laughed at the sight, shaking his head as he got up and dressed.
He opened the door and was greeted by Juechen.
"Good morning, Junior Brother Qingyi, the prisoner is ready, the others are waiting in the dungeon."
"Good morning, Senior Brother Juechen, has something happened?" Qingyi asked, noticing the tension in Juenchen’s shoulders.

"The bastards attacked three other villages during the night and completely wiped out the local population. Whatever they’re planning to do with so many people, it’s not going to be a good thing." Juechen replied, unable to hide a flash of anger in his voice.
"They’ll pay for it." Qingyi said, following Juechen down the corridor.
He himself couldn’t stop his heart from trembling slightly.
So many people... surely there were women and children among them too.
He was a selfish man and far from a hero, but he wasn’t so cruel as to ignore the suffering of these people.
"Yes, they will." Juenche repeated.
The two of them walked through the lord’s mansion, soon descending a dark, cold staircase that revealed a deep, stuffy dungeon, poorly lit by torches spaced every few dozen meters.
There were hundreds of prisoners there, resting on piles of their own excrement and tied to the walls by chains that sucked their Qi incessantly.
The nauseating smell made Qingyi shudder.
God... when was the last time he’d been in a place like this? No, had he even been in such a horrible place in his entire life?
"Don’t feel sorry for them," one of the guards approached.

"Ordinary criminals don’t stay here. Each one of them is a monster whose crimes are so repugnant that I don’t even dare mention them." He clicked his tongue in disgust, leading Qingyi and Juechen to a steel door.
When they opened the heavy door, they found Ruhu and Huntao already waiting for them.
In a corner, Qingyi could see the demonic cultivator.
His mask no longer covered his face, revealing aged features distorted by hatred.
With a soft sigh, the handsome young man walked up to the demonic cultivator and knelt down in front of him.
"Ah... do you think your torture is going to make me say something, brat? I’m already dead."
The demonic cultivator revealed a bloody smile, which Qingyi responded to with his lips rising gently.
"Yes, you’re dead, but..." Qingyi pointed a single finger covered in thunderous Qi towards the man’s big toe.
"This death could be a lot less painful."
Qingyi’s calm voice was answered with desperate screams as flesh, skin and bone were torn apart, the cultivator’s big toe being reduced to a bloody, smoking mess.
"Are you from the demon cult? What are you doing outside the nine peaks basin?" The handsome young man asked, moving his finger to the cultivator’s other toe.

"Ugh... Fuck you, you pretty-faced son of a bitch!" The cultivator cursed through his tears, his body writhing as Qingyi destroyed another of his fingers, collapsing my meridians and melting his skin and flesh to the bone.
Qingyi’s three companions couldn’t help but shudder at the sight, smelling the scent of burning flesh.
They even wondered if Qingyi himself had the stomach to do something like this the day before, but it seemed that they were the ones who needed the stomach the most.
"Why are you kidnapping those people?" Qingyi asked again, ignoring the man’s cries.
" Because..." The demonic cultivator opened his mouth, a smile appearing on Qingyi’s face.
It looked like it would be easier than he thought, but unfortunately, Qingyi didn’t get the answer he was expecting.
"M-my dick in yours-" The demonic cultivator shouted.
Qingyi’s face crumbled into a cold expression, his fist hitting the cultivator’s jaw with a dry thud and shutting him up.
"It seems you really enjoy suffering." Qingyi continued the torture, ignoring the cries of despair and pain that echoed through the chamber.
After finishing with all the toes, Qingyi moved on to the fingers before finally attacking the feet and hands themselves.
Still, the demonic cultivator didn’t speak, turning all his despair into curses, his eyes rolling back as he arched his body.
"Ah..." Qingyi finally pulled away, looking at the distorted and broken shoulders of the cultivator whose consciousness had faded.
Picking up a healing pill, he tossed it into the man’s mouth.
"I don’t think that bastard’s going to say anything," he turned to Juechen, who just shook his head.
"Let’s wait for him to recover and do another round. He’s going to break at some point."
"YOUNG MASTER JUECHEN!" A loud voice caught everyone’s attention and a panting soldier burst into the torture chamber.
"A new attack has just taken place in a village ten kilometers to the north! A guard has been sent and they’re fighting off the attackers right now!" The soldier spoke hurriedly.
"Come on, now!" Juechen roared, running out of the dungeon before activating his movement technique.
Qingyi followed soon after, activating his lightning steps.
His body was covered in a thunderous aura as the four of them tore through the skies towards the attacked village.

chapters.title: Chapter 145 - Fragments
paragraphs: "Shit, we’re too late!" Juechan stopped his steps, his eyes brimming with anger as he gazed at the sea of corpses piled up on the snow.
The entire guard had been massacred along with a large part of the local population.
Qingyi entered the village, his eyes scanning the surrounding massacre.
"Qingyi... I’m sensing something." Ruxue’s sweet, mature voice echoed in his head, making him stop. "I think it might be one of my fragments."
’A fragment?’ His eyes widened.
’Where exactly? We need to get it right now!’ His voice suddenly died as a thought popped into his mind.
’Ruxue, you said that demons only exist in the celestial heavens. But it’s still possible to summon them to the mortal heaven, right?’ He asked.
"Yes, but that would require a powerful vessel and an absurd amount of souls-..." Ruxue froze, finally understanding what he meant.
Her fragment in a perfect container, an item from the heavenly sky that had already been bathed in the blood of countless demons.
Apart from the container, all they needed was thousands of sacrifices.
The handsome young man gritted his teeth and raised his head.
"Can you detect the location of your fragment?"
"Yes, it’s not far away."
Qingyi turned to Juechen. "Senior brother, I have a detection skill that might allow me to see where they’ve gone. What do you say we try that?"
"Hm... I don’t think we have many better options." Juechen shook his head, drawing a smile from Qingyi.
"If you had that ability, why didn’t you use it in the very first village we passed through? What proves that you’re not leading us into a trap?" Ruhu asked in a voice laced with venom.
"The attack there wasn’t recent enough. My technique follows trails of Qi, which disappear quickly. If you don’t want us to lose this one, you’d better move quickly."
"Don’t you dare give me orders-"
"Enough!" Juechen raised his hand. "Lead the way, Qingyi. We need to move fast if we want to find anyone alive."
Qingyi just nodded, activating his lightning steps and following Ruxue’s directions.
They ran for almost an hour until Ruxue finally instructed him to stop.
"It’s below us..." Qingyi spoke, crouching down and touching the icy snow.
"Below us? I can’t detect anything-" Juechen’s words were interrupted by a deafening crash.
The ground beneath his feet shook as the snow gave way.
"Damn it, I told you it was a trap!" Ruhu shouted as the four of them were swallowed up by the snow.
"Shut the fuck up and focus on surviving this!" Qingyi growled, already fed up with Ruhu’s complaining.
The man of little beauty shut up, gritting his teeth.
Soon, they found themselves falling into an obscure cave, their bodies sinking into a lake.
"Ugh... What kind of fucking water is this?" Huntao was the first to swim to the shore, using his fire Qi to form a small flaming ball on his finger.
He regretted it the next moment, his eyes filling with terror as bile rose in his throat.
"Fuck..." Qingyi plunged an arm into the liquid, grabbing something in the depths and pulling.
It was a man with a decomposing face, emerging briefly from the water before Qingyi pushed him down again.
"That’s a fucking lake of blood!" He shouted as everyone rushed out of the lake.
"Look up," Huntao’s trembling voice echoed as he pointed to the ceiling.
There were at least a hundred corpses hanging there, a small stream of blood running down the rips in their necks and dripping onto the floor.
From how fresh they were, they were probably the abductees from the last attack.
"I very much doubt there’s anyone alive here..." Qingyi stood up on the shore of the lake, forcing firmness into his voice.
Suddenly, they heard thousands of sharp whistles cutting through the air.
They were throwing knives, each covered in putrid demonic Qi.
"DEFEND YOURSELF!" Juechen roared, realizing the danger and activating his defense skills.
"Shit..." Qingyi grunted as he activated his draconic eyes and, under his clothes, the black scales covered just enough to protect his vital organs.
The world around him slowed down and he only needed an instant to map all the knives coming towards him.
Calming his breathing, he began to swing his sword.
Each impact was powerful enough to make his arms tremble, but never enough to slow his momentum.
Even with so many knives at once and at such speed, that was only a fraction of what he needed to defend himself against his master’s attack.
The Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword turned into a brilliant blur, its thunderous lightning taking over everything around it as the sword Qi cut the knives in half.
After more than thirty seconds and hundreds of knives piling up at his feet, they finally stopped coming, the last one falling onto the pile with a metallic clang.
His breathing was panting, but not a single cut could be seen on his already blood-soaked robes.
He turned his face, looking at the other three who were not in such good condition.
They had managed to protect all their vital points, but their bodies were still covered in horrible wounds.
Fortunately, that wasn’t much for cultivators of their level.
Having suffered no damage to their meridians, they only needed a good healing pill to recover completelly.
"Ah..." A long, aged sigh echoed, followed by a high-pitched, crazed laugh.
"Look at the little gifts that came to me... bodies of such quality, with so much vitality..."
Heavy footsteps echoed and a figure appeared on the horizon, her Qi of the third stage of the Iron Body realm exploding.
It was an old woman, her body covered in hideous tumors, her hump rising more than two meters high while her long neck curled in on itself as she sniffed the air.
Qingyi couldn’t help but shudder at the sight, but it wasn’t the woman’s appearance that caused him to react.
It was what she carried in her hands: a piece of purplish silver blade, powerful and covered in thunderous patterns.

"Qingyi...

But it’s still possible to summon them to the mortal heaven, right?’ He asked.
"Yes, but that would require a powerful vessel and an absurd amount of souls-..." Ruxue froze, finally understanding what he meant.
Her fragment in a perfect container, an item from the heavenly sky that had already been bathed in the blood of countless demons.
Apart from the container, all they needed was thousands of sacrifices.
The handsome young man gritted his teeth and raised his head.
"Can you detect the location of your fragment?"
"Yes, it’s not far away."
Qingyi turned to Juechen.
"Senior brother, I have a detection skill that might allow me to see where they’ve gone.
What do you say we try that?"
I don’t think we have many better options." Juechen shook his head, drawing a smile from Qingyi.

chapters.title: Chapter 146 - Upgrade
paragraphs: ’Is this one of your fragments?’ Qingyi asked Ruxue, taking a single step back.
That old woman was powerful, even among cultivators of the third stage of the Iron Body Realm.
"Yes, for those damned pigs to dare to dishonor my steel like that..." The spiritual beauty couldn’t hide the angry tremor in her voice.
She only controlled herself when she felt Qingyi’s gentle grip on the hilt of the heaven-defying thunder sword.
"They’ll pay for this," Qingyi whispered as the sword slid out of its sheath.
"Who the hell are you? What are you doing to so many innocent people?" Juechen’s voice exploded as he stood up, his great sword gleaming gold as he held it tightly.
"Me? I’m... uh... A good servant of my lord, the lord who will bring true light to this cursed world!"
The old woman shouted, her long neck stretching almost two meters while a smile revealed rotten teeth and a black tongue.
"And you will be the fuel for it!"
" You wretch!" Juechen gritted his teeth, his feet sinking into the ground as his body exploded towards the old woman.
"Wait!" Huntao tried to stop him, but it was too late.
The old woman raised the piece of steel in her hand, defending herself against Juechen’s great sword.
She didn’t even tremble, her Iron Body Realm aura surrounding Juechen as her face was filled with a distorted smile.
"Yes... that’s decent strength! Your blood will be of great help."
She pressed down and Juechen’s body was thrown backwards, hitting the wall with a thud.
Without giving the others time to react, she got down on all fours, her long, sharp, thin fingers tearing at the ground as her mouth opened unnaturally wide.
In the next moment, she screamed, her hoarse, thunderous voice echoing around the room, bringing all four of them to their knees.
"S-shit..." Ruhu clutched his ears, feeling the blood pool between his fingers as his eardrums burst.
He barely managed to stay conscious for more than a few moments before everything was overtaken by darkness.
"Master, what should we do with them?" A shadowy figure landed next to the old woman, fifty others appearing behind him.
"They’ll be sacrifices too. With four bodies of such high quality, our master will surely be very happy! Hahahaha!" The old woman laughed as she turned away.
The demonic cultivators jumped over the lake of blood, each of them grabbing one of the disciples with the intention of throwing them into the lake.
But one of them suddenly stopped, a guttural choke escaped his lips and he shuddered.
"Uh? What’s going on?" One of the demonic cultivators looked at his companion, his eyes widening in realization.
There was a bloody sword sticking out of his back, his pounding heart still beating at the tip of the blade.
"Fuck!" The demonic cultivator let go of Juechen and tried to draw his sword, but it was too late.
Qingyi was already upon him, his eyes glowing with an intense purple light as he used the first form of the tempestuous monarch’s sword art.
The heaven-defying thunder sword easily overcame the demon cultivator’s defenses, piercing his throat and launching his head into the air.
"You all die today!" Qingyi roared, using the second form of the Storm Monarch’s sword art towards the other demonic cultivators.
Desperate cries rang out as the blade of thunderous Qi expanded.
Not even those at the peak of the Golden Core realm were able to defend themselves.
The strongest among them held off the attack for a single moment before his abdomen was ripped open and he fell to the ground, choking on his own blood.

"Did you resist that?" The old woman’s eyes widened. "No... it’s impossible, that was a gift from the lord to me, that attack is a gift, HOW DARE YOU RESIST THAT?" She shuddered, opening her mouth again.
Another loud scream echoed, but Qingyi was unaffected.

The three-bladed monarch’s set already protected his body well against that kind of attack that used Qi, and the little that passed through the set was just enough to cause a slight tingling in his eardrums.
Even without the set, his constitution alone would be more than enough to resist it.
He took a single step forward, smoothly and lightly, his panting breath slowly coming under control before he used the lightning steps.
The shock on the old woman’s face deepened as Qingyi’s body disappeared in a dark, thunderous cloud that soon became a blur.
In the blink of an eye, he was already above her.
"I just need to come into contact with the fragment and I’ll be able to absorb it!" Ruxue’s voice echoed in Qingyi’s head, who only nodded positively.
Raising the heaven-defying thunder sword over his head, he used the third form of the Storm Monarch’s sword art, a descending cut falling on the old woman.
"DON’T DARE!" The old woman roared, her hideous body distorting as she turned, using the steel fragment in her hands to defend herself.
’That’s exactly what I wanted!’ A huge smile appeared on Qingyi’s face.
A metallic clang echoed, the old woman’s eyes filling with terror as her thin, fragile arms broke, unable to cope with Qingyi’s strength.
But it wasn’t her broken arms that made her eyes fill with terror.
In fact, it was seeing the fragment of metal melting between her fingers that did it.
"N-no! Impossible! Impossible! Impossible!" The old woman repeated to herself without stopping as the last piece of metal left her hands.
everything flowed towards the heaven-defying thunder sword, spinning around the purple-silver blade before slowly being absorbed by it.
Qingyi paid no attention to the old woman’s crazed words.
His eyes were totally focused on the flurry of system messages reaching him.
[You have recovered one of the fragments of the heaven-defying thunder sword! 2/9]
[The heaven-defying thunder sword has been upgraded! Rare Grade -> Legendary Grade]
[A new feature has been unlocked in the heaven-defying thunder sword: World of Mind].

chapters.title: Chapter 147 - Demon
paragraphs: "Ruxue, what is a world of mind?" Qingyi asked, unable to hide the faint smile on his lips.
He knew the concept of a sea of mind, unlocked when a cultivator reached the Nascent Soul Realm, but a world of mind was a completely new term for him.
"I’ll explain later, get rid of that damned old woman!" Ruxue replied, her voice slightly hurried.
She still seemed to be having trouble fully synchronizing with her fragment.
Qingyi swung the heaven-defying thunder sword, using the movement to wipe away the disgusting blood that permeated the beautiful, elegant blade.
"N-no... impossible..." The old woman muttered, barely feeling the cold steel pressing against her neck.
Qingyi pressed down, his lightning sword qi flashing as his blade sank into the aged flesh.
"IMPOSSIBLE!" The old woman screamed, her aura of the third stage of the Iron Body Realm exploding from her body.
"Ugh... how does that wretch still have so much power?" Qingyi gritted his teeth as he was forced to take a step back.
He activated the third form of the Storm Monarch’s sword art, a dry explosion echoing as the blade tore through the air.
"THAT WAS A GIFT FROM MY LORD, YOU’LL PAY FOR IT!"
The old woman raised her body, opening her mouth and sinking her rotting teeth into the heaven-defying thunder sword.
Qingyi gritted his teeth and kept pushing, his meridians seeming to scream in agony as he pushed all his Qi towards the blade.
’Shit... it’s still not enough!’ Qingyi opened the system store, ignoring the pain spreading through his body as he pressed on to improve his cultivation.
[Your cultivation has improved! Sixth stage of the Golden Core Realm -> Seventh stage of the Golden Core Realm]
The momentum of this breakthrough was all he needed.
His Qi, which had previously only been on the same level as the old woman’s, finally beat her completely, the difference in cultivation between them reduced to nothing.
"Die!" Qingyi roared, his lightning Qi turning the old woman’s jaw to dust as the sword Qi cut through the back of her head, splitting her face in half.
The moment the top of the old woman’s head touched the ground, her body blasted Qingyi away.
His body was thrown hundreds of meters until it hit a wall on the other side of the lake.
"What the fuck..." The handsome young man shuddered, feeling a few broken ribs and coughing up a gulp of blood.
Raising his gaze, he saw the decapitated body dragging itself along, its sickly old hands sinking into the earth as it tried to reach the lake of blood.
"Don’t let her touch you-" Ruxue’s voice echoed in his head, but it was too late.
The old woman’s sickly body sank into the lake of blood, which immediately shook.
A deep demonic Qi spread as the blood was sucked towards the old woman’s body.
"That bitch wants to use her own body as a vessel for the demon!" Ruxue said.
"How can I stop it?"
"It’s impossible, not with your current cultivation. Don’t go near her and try to escape!" Ruxue warned and Qingyi looked up, preparing his lightning steps.
"You’re not going anywhere." A voice rang out, making Qingyi’s blood shiver softly.
That wasn’t the aged, crazed voice of the old woman.
It was masculine, soft and composed.
Qingyi’s eyes focused on the now empty pool of blood. A man was standing in the center of it.
His face was beautiful, adorned with two crimson horns, but his body was distorted, covered in pulsating tumors.
"Ugh... these damn mortal heaven bugs can’t even find a decent host. What am I supposed to do with that?"
The man complained, his beautiful red eyes focusing on Qingyi.

"You’re a good host, mortal." He smiled, his eyes fixed on the heaven-defying thunder sword. "Why don’t you leave that disgusting item behind and give yourself to me? I’ll give you endless pleasures!"
Qingyi couldn’t stop his face from distorting in disgust as he took a step forward, feeling the Qi exhaled by the demon man.
That man was stronger than the old woman, but not strong enough.
With a sigh, he activated the lightning steps, his body exploding in speed as he used the first form of the Stormy Monarch sword art.
"Futile resistance of a useless insect," the man raised a single finger, sensing Qingyi’s power.
To his surprise, the blade didn’t stop immediately as he had expected.
A painful grunt escaped his lips as the Qi from Qingyi’s lightning sword tore through his hand, sinking into his chest.
"How?" His eyes filled with shock, but Qingyi gave him no time to react.
Taking out the talisman he had received from his master, he took a step backwards as he tore it open.
At that distance, it was impossible to dodge.
A powerful wind and sword Qi spread across the dry lake, turning into hundreds of slashes that exploded towards the man.
"Ugh... you bastard, you’ll pay for this!" The man gritted his teeth, his body melting as his crimson horns turned into red lightning, flying towards the sky.
"Ah... was that a demon? What happened to it?" Qingyi asked, falling to his knees.

"Yes, fortunately that wasn’t a complete form. If they had used my fragment instead of the old woman’s body, the entire kingdom - no, the entire Blue Moon Continent would have been completely wiped off the map in a single breath."
Qingyi couldn’t help but shudder at those words.
He could hardly imagine what would have happened if that ritual had been a success.
With a weary sigh, he closed his eyes.
Ruhu was the first of the four to wake up, stumbling towards the banks of the now dry lake.
His eyes fluttered as he saw Qingyi’s kneeling figure.
"That bastard managed to kill that monster all by himself? How is that possible?" Ruhu was unable to stop his heart from sinking gently.
How could Qingyi be so strong?
He felt ashamed, but that shame soon turned to hatred.
He gripped his sword tightly. This was his chance.
He approached, aligned the blade with Qingyi’s neck and swung.
A metallic clang echoed as the sword bounced off Qingyi’s skin, covered in black scales.
"You’re pretty bold, aren’t you?" Qingyi stood up.
"M-monster!" Ruhu fell on his butt, hastily trying to retreat.
"Know your place, worm." Qingyi pressed his foot against Ruhu’s head, only stopping when he felt the loud crack of bones breaking and brains being crushed.
